<!doctype html>
<html lang="bn">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>HexaMart — Online Shop</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#fffaf5;--panel:#fff;--soft:#fff0df;--orange:#f97316;--orange2:#ea580c;--text:#29211b;--muted:#85786e;--line:#f0dfcf;--green:#16835d;--red:#c2413a}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Noto Sans Bengali",sans-serif}button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer;border:0;border-radius:11px;padding:10px 14px;font-weight:750;background:var(--orange);color:#fff}button:hover{background:var(--orange2)}.secondary{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--text)}.secondary:hover{background:var(--soft)}.danger{background:#b93830}.order-status{background:#f3f4f6;color:#29211b;border:1px solid #e5e7eb}.order-status.active{background:#16a34a!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:#16a34a!important}.remove-order{background:#fff;border:1px solid #d1d5db;color:#374151}.remove-order:hover{background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b}.wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:auto;padding:18px}.top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 0 20px}.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:27px;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:-1px;color:var(--text);white-space:nowrap}.brand-logo{width:48px;height:48px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:10px;background:#050505;display:block}.settings-icon{width:46px;height:46px;padding:0;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:24px;border-radius:14px}.brand span{color:var(--orange)}.search{flex:1;min-width:170px;max-width:440px;background:white;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--text);padding:12px 14px;border-radius:12px}.actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.hero{padding:30px;border:1px solid #ffd2a6;border-radius:22px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#ffead3,#fff8ef 72%);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;margin-bottom:22px}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(28px,5vw,44px);margin:0 0 10px}.hero p{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 18px}.hero-art{font-size:78px}.sectionhead{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin:24px 0 14px}.sectionhead h2{font-size:22px;margin:0}.chips{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.chip{background:white;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:8px 13px;border-radius:999px;color:var(--muted)}.chip.active{background:var(--orange);color:white;border-color:var(--orange)}.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}.product{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:17px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 3px 12px #713b1208}.product .pic{height:155px;background:var(--soft);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:58px;overflow:hidden}.product .pic img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}.product .info{padding:13px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;flex:1}.product h3{font-size:15px;margin:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.muted{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}.price{font-size:20px;font-weight:900;color:var(--orange2)}.stock{font-size:12px;color:var(--green);font-weight:700}.stock.out{color:var(--red)}.product button{margin-top:auto}.panel{background:white;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:17px;padding:18px;margin:18px 0}.hidden{display:none!important}.row{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.row>*{flex:1}.field{width:100%;padding:11px 12px;background:#fffdfb;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;color:var(--text);margin:5px 0 12px}.label{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}.itemrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:12px 0}.itemrow:last-child{border-bottom:0}.itememoji{font-size:28px}.itemgrow{flex:1}.qty{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}.qty button{padding:4px 10px}.total{font-size:21px;font-weight:900;text-align:right;padding:15px 0}.notice{padding:12px;border-radius:10px;background:#e5f7ed;color:#166344;margin:12px 0}.warning{color:#9a5a11;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5}.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px}.stat{background:#fff5e9;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;padding:14px}.stat strong{font-size:24px;display:block}.order{padding:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;margin:10px 0}.orderhead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}.badge{display:inline-block;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:#ffead3;color:#9a430c;font-size:12px}.empty{text-align:center;padding:25px;color:var(--muted)}.adminProduct{display:grid;grid-template-columns:62px 1fr auto;gap:12px;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:12px 0}.adminProduct:last-child{border-bottom:0}.adminProduct img{width:60px;height:60px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:10px;background:var(--soft)}.adminProduct .emoji{width:60px;height:60px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--soft);border-radius:10px;font-size:28px}.foot{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;padding:25px 0}@media(max-width:850px){.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.hero-art{font-size:54px}}@media(max-width:480px){.wrap{padding:12px}.brand{font-size:23px}.brand-logo{width:42px;height:42px}.hero{padding:20px}.hero-art{display:none}.grid{gap:10px}.product .pic{height:125px;font-size:46px}.product .info{padding:10px}.stats{grid-template-columns:1fr}.adminProduct{grid-template-columns:52px 1fr}.adminProduct .adminButtons{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;gap:8px}.adminProduct img,.adminProduct .emoji{width:50px;height:50px}}
.customer-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px;margin:10px 0;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}.customer-avatar{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--soft);font-size:22px;flex-shrink:0}.customer-main{flex:1;min-width:0}.customer-main strong{display:block;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.customer-detail{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:16px;margin:14px 0}.timer-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}.timer-grid input{min-width:0}.timer-chip{display:inline-block;background:#fff0c2;color:#7c4a03;border-radius:9px;padding:5px 9px;font-weight:800;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.lang-option{width:100%;margin:7px 0;text-align:left;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--text);padding:15px}.lang-option.active{border-color:var(--orange);background:var(--soft)}.icon-btn{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;font-size:22px;padding:0;display:grid;place-items:center}.settings-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}.small-muted{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}@media(max-width:480px){.timer-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}

/* HexaMart interaction fixes */
.settings-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.link-button{background:transparent;color:var(--orange2);padding:4px 6px;text-decoration:underline;box-shadow:none}
#adminOrderPanel.product-order-screen{position:fixed!important;inset:12px;z-index:1000;overflow:auto;background:var(--bg);border:2px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 18px 70px #0005;border-radius:20px;padding:18px;max-width:760px;margin:auto;max-height:calc(100dvh - 24px)}
#adminOrderPanel .sectionhead{position:sticky;top:-18px;background:var(--bg);z-index:2;padding:8px 0}
#accountView{min-height:50vh}
.history-line{border-left:3px solid var(--orange);padding:8px 12px;margin:8px 0;background:#fffaf5;border-radius:0 10px 10px 0}.transaction-code{font-family:monospace;overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-weight:800;color:#c2410c}.tracking-result{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px;margin-top:14px}.tracking-time{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-weight:800}
.new-order-badge{display:inline-block;background:#ffd9d9;color:#b42318;border-radius:999px;padding:2px 7px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;margin-left:4px}.tab-active{background:#f97316!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:#f97316!important}

/* HEXAMART pink + white palette — colors only */
:root{
 --bg:#ffffff;--panel:#ffffff;--soft:#fff0f7;
 --orange:#c00068;--orange2:#97004f;
 --text:#28212a;--muted:#827583;--line:#f4cfe2;
 --green:#16835d;--red:#c2413a;
}
body{background:#fff;color:#28212a}
.top{background:#fff0f7}
.brand span{color:#c00068}
.brand-logo{background:#fff}
.search{background:#fff;border-color:#f3c8dd}
button{background:#c00068;color:#fff}
button:hover{background:#97004f}
.secondary{background:#fff;border-color:#f1c7dc;color:#473342}
.secondary:hover{background:#ffe5f1}
.hero{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#f7b2d2,#fff0f7 72%);border-color:#e78ab7}
.hero h1,.hero h2{color:#870047}
.chip{background:#ffe0ef;border-color:#e9a0c3;color:#870047}
.chip.active,.tab-active{background:#c00068!important;border-color:#c00068!important;color:#fff!important}
.product,.product-card,.product-item{background:#fff1f7;border-color:#e9a0c3}
.product .pic,.product .image,.product-image{background:#f8c4dc}
.price{color:#b0005d}
.panel,.customer-detail{background:#fff;border-color:#f2c9dd}
.stat{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#ffe3ef,#fff);border-color:#e9a0c3}
.stat strong{color:#b0005d}
.order,.tracking-result,.customer-card{background:#fff;border-color:#f1c9dd}
.customer-avatar{background:#f8c4dc;color:#97004f}
.badge{background:#f8c4dc;color:#870047;border-color:#e78ab7}
#adminCoinPanel{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#ffe3ef)!important;border-color:#e78ab7!important}
#plearWorkspace{background:#fff}
.empty{background:#fff3f8;border-color:#e78ab7}
.remove-order:hover{background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b}

</style></head>
<body><div class="wrap">
<header class="top"><div class="brand"><img class="brand-logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="HexaMart লোগো"><span><span style="color:#f97316">Hexa</span>Mart</span></div><input id="search" class="search" placeholder="পণ্যের নাম লিখে খুঁজুন..." aria-label="পণ্য খুঁজুন"><div class="actions"><button class="secondary" id="cartBtn">🛒 কার্ট <span id="cartCount">0</span></button><button class="secondary settings-icon" id="settingsBtn" aria-label="অ্যাডমিন সেটিংস" title="অ্যাডমিন প্যানেল">⚙</button></div></header>
<section id="shopView"><div class="hero"><div><h1>আপনার পছন্দ,<br><span style="color:#ea580c">এক ক্লিকেই!</span></h1><p>HexaMart-এ পণ্য খুঁজুন এবং সহজে অর্ডার করুন।</p><button onclick="document.getElementById('productsTitle').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})">পণ্য দেখুন ↓</button></div><div class="hero-art">🛍️</div></div><div class="sectionhead"><h2 id="productsTitle">সব পণ্য</h2><span class="muted" id="productCount"></span></div><div class="chips" id="categories"></div><div class="grid" id="productGrid" style="margin-top:14px"></div></section>
<section id="cartView" class="hidden"><div class="sectionhead"><h2>🛒 আপনার কার্ট</h2><button class="secondary" id="backShop">← শপে ফিরুন</button></div><div class="panel"><div id="cartItems"></div><div id="cartTotal" class="total"></div><h3>অর্ডারের তথ্য</h3><form id="checkoutForm"><label class="label" for="customerName">আপনার নাম</label><input class="field" id="customerName" required placeholder="সম্পূর্ণ নাম"><label class="label" for="phone">মোবাইল নম্বর</label><input class="field" id="phone" required inputmode="tel" placeholder="01XXXXXXXXX"><label class="label" for="address">ডেলিভারি ঠিকানা</label><textarea class="field" id="address" required rows="3" placeholder="বাসা, রোড, এলাকা, জেলা"></textarea><label class="label" for="payment">পেমেন্ট পদ্ধতি</label><select class="field" id="payment"><option>ক্যাশ অন ডেলিভারি</option><option>নগদ</option><option>বিকাশ</option></select><div id="paymentGuide" class="panel hidden"></div><label class="label" for="transactionInput">ট্রানজেকশন আইডি</label><input class="field" id="transactionInput" placeholder="নগদ/বিকাশের ট্রানজেকশন আইডি"><button type="submit" style="width:100%">অর্ডার নিশ্চিত করুন</button><p class="warning">ডেমো: অর্ডার এই ব্রাউজারে সেভ হবে। বিভিন্ন গ্রাহকের অর্ডার এক অ্যাডমিনের কাছে পেতে অনলাইন ডেটাবেস/সার্ভার লাগবে।</p></form></div></section>
<section id="adminView" class="hidden"><div class="sectionhead"><h2>⚙ HexaMart Admin Panel</h2><button class="secondary" id="backFromAdmin">← শপে ফিরুন</button></div>
<div id="adminLogin" class="panel"><h3>অ্যাডমিন লগইন</h3><form id="loginForm"><label class="label" for="adminPass">পাসওয়ার্ড</label><input class="field" id="adminPass" type="password" placeholder="অ্যাডমিন পাসওয়ার্ড" required><button type="submit">লগইন</button><p id="loginError" class="warning"></p></form><p class="warning">অর্ডারের নাম, মোবাইল ও ঠিকানা শুধু এই ব্রাউজারের অ্যাডমিন প্যানেলে দেখানো হয়। তবে এটি লোকাল HTML ডেমো—আসল অনলাইন গোপনীয়তা ও নিরাপত্তার জন্য সার্ভারভিত্তিক লগইন দরকার।</p></div>
<div id="adminDashboard" class="hidden"><div class="stats"><div class="stat"><span class="muted">মোট পণ্য</span><strong id="statProducts">0</strong></div><div class="stat"><span class="muted">মোট অর্ডার</span><strong id="statOrders">0</strong></div><div class="stat"><span class="muted">মোট স্টক</span><strong id="statStock">0</strong></div></div>
<div class="row" id="adminMainTabs" style="margin:16px 0;flex-wrap:wrap"><button type="button" id="tabProducts">📦 পণ্য</button><button type="button" class="secondary" id="tabCustomers">👥 গ্রাহক <small id="newOrderBadge" class="new-order-badge hidden"></small></button><button type="button" class="secondary" id="tabHistory">📚 হিস্ট্রি</button><button type="button" class="secondary" id="tabPlear">👤 Plear</button></div>
<div id="adminCustomerManager" class="panel hidden"><div class="sectionhead"><h3 id="customerManagerTitle">👥 গ্রাহক — পণ্য নির্বাচন করুন</h3><button type="button" class="secondary hidden" id="customerBack">← ফিরে যান</button></div><div id="customerProductsList"></div><div id="productCustomersList" class="hidden"></div><div id="singleCustomerDetail" class="hidden"></div></div>
<div id="adminProductsWorkspace">
<div id="productManagementWorkspace">
<div class="panel"><h3 id="productFormTitle">➕ নতুন পণ্য যোগ করুন</h3><form id="productForm"><input id="editId" type="hidden"><div class="row"><div><label class="label" for="pName">পণ্যের নাম *</label><input class="field" id="pName" required placeholder="যেমন: Wireless Headphones"></div><div><label class="label" for="pCategory">ক্যাটাগরি</label><input class="field" id="pCategory" placeholder="যেমন: ইলেকট্রনিক্স"></div></div><div class="row"><div><label class="label" for="pPrice">দাম (৳) *</label><input class="field" id="pPrice" type="number" min="0" step="1" required placeholder="1000"></div><div><label class="label" for="pStock">স্টক / কয়টি আছে *</label><input class="field" id="pStock" type="number" min="0" step="1" required placeholder="10"></div></div><label class="label" for="pDesc">অ্যাডমিনের জন্য ছোট বিবরণ (গ্রাহক দেখবে না)</label><textarea class="field" id="pDesc" rows="2" placeholder="শুধু অ্যাডমিনের জন্য"></textarea><div class="row"><div><label class="label" for="pDelivery">ডেলিভারি চার্জ (৳)</label><input class="field" id="pDelivery" type="number" min="0" value="0"></div><div><label class="label" for="pVideo">পণ্যের ভিডিও</label><input class="field" id="pVideo" type="file" accept="video/*"></div></div><label class="label" for="pImage">পণ্যের ছবি (আপলোড করুন)</label><input class="field" id="pImage" type="file" accept="image/*"><p class="warning">JPG, PNG বা WebP ছবি বেছে নিন। ছবি স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে ছোট করে সেভ হবে।</p><div class="row"><button type="submit" id="saveProductBtn">পণ্য সেভ করুন</button><button type="button" class="secondary hidden" id="cancelEdit">এডিট বাতিল</button></div></form></div>
<div class="sectionhead"><h2>📦 আপনার পণ্যসমূহ</h2><span class="muted">এডিট/মুছুন করতে অপশন ব্যবহার করুন</span></div><div class="panel" id="adminProducts"></div></div></div><div class="panel hidden" id="adminOrderPanel"><div class="sectionhead"><h3 style="margin:0">🧾 অর্ডার ফর্ম</h3><button type="button" class="secondary" id="closeAdminOrder">বন্ধ করুন</button></div><div id="adminOrderProduct" class="notice"></div><form id="adminOrderForm"><label class="label" for="adminUsername">গ্রাহকের ইউজারনেম *</label><input class="field" id="adminUsername" required placeholder="যেমন: customer123"><label class="label" for="adminCustomer">গ্রাহকের নাম *</label><input class="field" id="adminCustomer" required placeholder="সম্পূর্ণ নাম"><label class="label" for="adminPhone">মোবাইল নম্বর *</label><input class="field" id="adminPhone" required inputmode="tel" placeholder="01XXXXXXXXX"><label class="label" for="adminAddress">সম্পূর্ণ ডেলিভারি ঠিকানা *</label><textarea class="field" id="adminAddress" required rows="3" placeholder="বাসা, রোড, এলাকা, জেলা"></textarea><div class="row"><div><label class="label" for="adminQty">পরিমাণ *</label><input class="field" id="adminQty" type="number" min="1" value="1" required></div><div><label class="label" for="adminPayment">পেমেন্ট পদ্ধতি</label><select class="field" id="adminPayment"><option>ক্যাশ অন ডেলিভারি</option><option>নগদ</option><option>বিকাশ</option></select></div></div><label class="label" data-i18n="timerLabel">অর্ডার কনফার্ম হওয়ার কাউন্টডাউন (ঐচ্ছিক)</label><div class="timer-grid"><div><label class="label" for="timerDays" data-i18n="days">দিন</label><input class="field" id="timerDays" type="number" min="0" value="0"></div><div><label class="label" for="timerHours" data-i18n="hours">ঘণ্টা</label><input class="field" id="timerHours" type="number" min="0" max="23" value="0"></div><div><label class="label" for="timerMinutes" data-i18n="minutes">মিনিট</label><input class="field" id="timerMinutes" type="number" min="0" max="59" value="0"></div><div><label class="label" for="timerSeconds" data-i18n="seconds">সেকেন্ড</label><input class="field" id="timerSeconds" type="number" min="0" max="59" value="0"></div></div><p class="small-muted" data-i18n="timerHelp">সময় ০ রাখলে কাউন্টডাউন হবে না। সময় শেষ হলে Pending অর্ডার নিজে থেকে Confirm হবে।</p><div class="total" id="adminOrderTotal"></div><button type="submit" style="width:100%" data-i18n="addOrder">অর্ডার লিস্টে যোগ করুন</button></form></div>
<div id="ordersWorkspace"><div class="sectionhead"><h2 id="ordersHeading">🧾 গ্রাহকের তালিকা (0 গ্রাহক)</h2><button class="secondary" id="exportOrders">অর্ডার ডাউনলোড</button></div><div id="ordersList"></div><div id="orderDetail" class="customer-detail hidden"></div></div><div id="historyWorkspace" class="hidden"><div class="sectionhead"><h3>📚 All Order History / সব অর্ডারের ইতিহাস</h3></div><div id="allOrderHistory"></div></div><div id="plearWorkspace" class="panel hidden"><div class="sectionhead"><h3>👤 Plear — রেজিস্টার্ড গ্রাহক</h3><span id="plearCount" class="badge">0 জন</span></div><p class="small-muted">রেজিস্ট্রেশনের সময় দেওয়া নাম, ইউজারনেম, ইমেইল ও সময় এখানে দেখা যাবে। নিরাপত্তার জন্য পাসওয়ার্ড দেখানো বা সংরক্ষণ করা হয় না।</p><input id="plearSearch" class="field" type="search" placeholder="নাম, ইউজারনেম বা ইমেইল দিয়ে খুঁজুন"><div id="plearList"></div></div>
<div class="panel"><h3>⚙ শপ সেটিংস</h3><div class="settings-row"><strong data-i18n="language">Language / ভাষা</strong><button type="button" class="secondary" id="openLanguage">🌐 Language</button></div><label class="label" for="storeName">শপের নাম</label><input class="field" id="storeName" value="HexaMart"><button id="saveSettings">সেটিংস সেভ</button><button class="secondary" id="logout" style="margin-left:6px">লগআউট</button><p class="warning">এই ডেমোর পণ্য, ছবি, দাম, স্টক ও অর্ডার একই ব্রাউজারের স্টোরেজে থাকে। HTML ফাইল মুছে ফেললে বা ব্রাউজারের ডেটা ক্লিয়ার করলে হারাতে পারে।</p></div></div></section>
<section id="settingsView" class="panel hidden" style="max-width:680px;margin:24px auto"><div class="sectionhead"><h2 data-i18n="settingsTitle">⚙ সেটিংস</h2><button class="secondary" id="closeSettings" type="button" data-i18n="backShop">← শপে ফিরুন</button></div><div class="settings-row"><strong data-i18n="language">🌐 ভাষা</strong><button class="secondary" id="settingsLanguage" type="button" data-i18n="openLanguage">🌐 ভাষা</button></div><div class="settings-row"><strong data-i18n="adminPanelLabel">🔐 অ্যাডমিন প্যানেল</strong><button class="secondary" id="settingsAdmin" type="button" data-i18n="adminPanelLabel">অ্যাডমিন প্যানেল</button></div><div class="settings-row"><strong data-i18n="accountLabel">👤 অ্যাকাউন্ট</strong><button class="secondary" id="accountLogout" type="button" data-i18n="logoutAccount">লগআউট</button></div></section>
<section id="trackingView" class="panel hidden" style="max-width:760px;margin:24px auto"><div class="sectionhead"><h2 id="trackingTitle">🧾 আপনার অর্ডার</h2><button type="button" class="secondary" id="closeTracking">← শপে ফিরুন</button></div><p id="trackingHelp" class="small-muted">আপনার ট্রানজেকশন আইডি লিখে অর্ডারের অবস্থা দেখুন।</p><form id="trackingForm"><label class="label" for="trackingCode">ট্রানজেকশন আইডি</label><input class="field" id="trackingCode" required placeholder="যেমন: HMTX-..." autocomplete="off"><button type="submit" style="width:100%">অর্ডার খুঁজুন</button></form><div id="trackingResult"></div></section>
<section id="accountView" class="panel hidden" style="max-width:520px;margin:24px auto"><h2 id="accountHeading">HexaMart অ্যাকাউন্ট</h2><div id="registerPane"><h3 data-i18n="registerTitle">অ্যাকাউন্ট খুলুন</h3><form id="registerForm"><label class="label" for="regUsername" data-i18n="username">ইউজারনেম</label><input class="field" id="regUsername" required minlength="3" autocomplete="username" placeholder="যেমন: sayem123"><label class="label" for="regName" data-i18n="fullName">আপনার নাম</label><input class="field" id="regName" required autocomplete="name"><label class="label" for="regEmail" data-i18n="email">ইমেইল</label><input class="field" id="regEmail" type="email" required autocomplete="email"><label class="label" for="regPassword" data-i18n="password">পাসওয়ার্ড</label><input class="field" id="regPassword" type="password" minlength="6" required autocomplete="new-password"><button type="submit" style="width:100%" data-i18n="registerBtn">রেজিস্টার</button><p><span data-i18n="alreadyAccount">আগে অ্যাকাউন্ট আছে?</span> <button type="button" class="link-button" id="showLogin" data-i18n="loginBtn">লগইন</button></p><p class="small-muted" data-i18n="localAccountNote">এই ডেমোতে অ্যাকাউন্ট এই ব্রাউজারে সংরক্ষিত হয়।</p></form></div><div id="accountLoginPane" class="hidden"><h3 data-i18n="loginTitle">লগইন করুন</h3><form id="accountLoginForm"><label class="label" for="loginEmail" data-i18n="email">ইমেইল</label><input class="field" id="loginEmail" type="email" required autocomplete="email"><label class="label" for="loginPassword" data-i18n="password">পাসওয়ার্ড</label><input class="field" id="loginPassword" type="password" required autocomplete="current-password"><button type="submit" style="width:100%" data-i18n="loginBtn">লগইন</button><p><span data-i18n="needAccount">অ্যাকাউন্ট নেই?</span> <button type="button" class="link-button" id="showRegister" data-i18n="registerBtn">রেজিস্টার</button></p><p id="accountError" class="warning"></p></form></div></section>
<section id="languageView" class="panel hidden"><div class="sectionhead"><h2 data-i18n="languageTitle">🌐 ভাষা নির্বাচন</h2><button class="secondary" id="closeLanguage">← ফিরে যান</button></div><button class="lang-option" id="chooseBn">🇧🇩 বাংলা</button><button class="lang-option" id="chooseEn">🇬🇧 English</button><p class="small-muted" data-i18n="languageHelp">ভাষা বেছে নিলে ইন্টারফেসের লেখা বদলাবে।</p></section><div id="toast" class="notice hidden" role="status"></div><footer class="foot">© 2026 HexaMart · White & Orange Shopping Demo</footer></div>
<script>
const ADMIN_PASSWORD="hexamartsayemmart";
const defaultProducts=[
{id:1,name:"Wireless Headphones",category:"ইলেকট্রনিক্স",price:1450,stock:10,emoji:"🎧",desc:"ওয়্যারলেস অডিও",image:""},
{id:2,name:"Smart Watch",category:"ইলেকট্রনিক্স",price:2250,stock:8,emoji:"⌚",desc:"স্মার্ট লাইফস্টাইল",image:""},
{id:3,name:"Casual Sneakers",category:"ফ্যাশন",price:1890,stock:6,emoji:"👟",desc:"প্রতিদিনের ফ্যাশন",image:""},
{id:4,name:"Travel Backpack",category:"ফ্যাশন",price:1250,stock:12,emoji:"🎒",desc:"ভ্রমণের সঙ্গী",image:""}
];
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const get=(key,fallback)=>{try{let v=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key));return v===null?fallback:v}catch{return fallback}};
let products=get("hexamart_products",defaultProducts),cart=get("hexamart_cart",{}),orders=get("hexamart_orders",[]),category="সব",imageData="",adminOrderProductId=null,selectedOrderId=null,currentLang=localStorage.getItem("hexamart_lang")||"bn";
function save(){try{localStorage.setItem("hexamart_products",JSON.stringify(products));localStorage.setItem("hexamart_cart",JSON.stringify(cart));localStorage.setItem("hexamart_orders",JSON.stringify(orders));return true}catch(err){toast("স্টোরেজ পূর্ণ হয়েছে। ছবিটি ছোট করে আবার চেষ্টা করুন বা পুরোনো পণ্য/অর্ডার সরান।");return false}}
function money(n){return "৳"+Number(n||0).toLocaleString("en-BD")}
function uniqueTx(){let id;do{id="HMTX-"+Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase()+"-"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10).toUpperCase()}while(orders.some(o=>o.transactionId===id));return id}
function esc(s){return String(s??"").replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;"}[c]))}
function toast(msg){$("toast").textContent=msg;$("toast").classList.remove("hidden");setTimeout(()=>$("toast").classList.add("hidden"),2800)}
function show(view){["shopView","cartView","adminView","languageView"].forEach(id=>{if($(id))$(id).classList.toggle("hidden",id!==view)});window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:"smooth"})}
function renderCategories(){let cats=["সব",...new Set(products.map(p=>p.category||"অন্যান্য"))];if(!cats.includes(category))category="সব";$("categories").innerHTML=cats.map(c=>`<button class="chip ${c===category?"active":""}" data-cat="${esc(c)}">${esc(c)}</button>`).join("");$("categories").querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{category=b.dataset.cat;renderCategories();renderProducts()})}
function renderProducts(){let q=$("search").value.trim().toLowerCase();let list=products.filter(p=>(category==="সব"||(p.category||"অন্যান্য")===category)&&(`${p.name} ${p.category} ${p.desc||""}`.toLowerCase().includes(q)));$("productCount").textContent=list.length+"টি পণ্য";$("productGrid").innerHTML=list.length?list.map(p=>`<article class="product"><div class="pic">${p.image?`<img src="${p.image}" alt="${esc(p.name)}">`:(p.emoji||"📦")}</div><div class="info"><span class="muted">${esc(p.category||"অন্যান্য")}</span><h3>${esc(p.name)}</h3><span class="muted">${esc(p.desc||"")}</span><div class="price">${money(p.price)}</div><span class="stock ${p.stock<=0?"out":""}">${p.stock>0?"স্টকে আছে: "+p.stock+"টি":"স্টক শেষ"}</span><button data-add="${p.id}" ${p.stock<=0?"disabled style='opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed'":""}>কার্টে যোগ করুন</button><button class="secondary" data-order-now="${p.id}" ${p.stock<=0?"disabled style='opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed'":""}>অর্ডার করুন</button><button class="secondary" type="button" data-share-product="${p.id}">🔗 পণ্য শেয়ার</button></div></article>`).join(""):`<div class="empty">কোনো পণ্য পাওয়া যায়নি।</div>`;$("productGrid").querySelectorAll("[data-add]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{let id=+b.dataset.add,p=products.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!p||p.stock<=0)return;if((cart[id]||0)>=p.stock){toast("স্টকের চেয়ে বেশি যোগ করা যাবে না।");return}cart[id]=(cart[id]||0)+1;save();updateCartCount();toast("পণ্য কার্টে যোগ হয়েছে!")});$("productGrid").querySelectorAll("[data-order-now]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{let id=+b.dataset.orderNow,p=products.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!p||p.stock<=0)return;cart={[id]:1};save();updateCartCount();show("cartView");renderCart();$("customerName").focus()})}
function updateCartCount(){$("cartCount").textContent=Object.values(cart).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)}
function renderCart(){let ids=Object.keys(cart).filter(id=>cart[id]>0&&products.some(p=>p.id===+id));$("cartItems").innerHTML=ids.length?ids.map(id=>{let p=products.find(x=>x.id===+id);return `<div class="itemrow"><span class="itememoji">${p.image?`<img src="${p.image}" style="width:42px;height:42px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px">`:(p.emoji||"📦")}</span><div class="itemgrow"><strong>${esc(p.name)}</strong><div class="muted">${money(p.price)} × ${cart[id]}</div></div><div class="qty"><button class="secondary" data-minus="${id}">−</button><b>${cart[id]}</b><button data-plus="${id}" ${cart[id]>=p.stock?"disabled":""}>+</button></div></div>`}).join(""):`<div class="empty">আপনার কার্ট খালি।</div>`;let total=ids.reduce((s,id)=>s+products.find(p=>p.id===+id).price*cart[id],0);$("cartTotal").textContent="মোট: "+money(total);$("checkoutForm").classList.toggle("hidden",!ids.length);$("cartItems").querySelectorAll("[data-minus]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{let id=b.dataset.minus;cart[id]--;if(cart[id]<=0)delete cart[id];save();renderCart();updateCartCount()});$("cartItems").querySelectorAll("[data-plus]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{let id=b.dataset.plus,p=products.find(x=>x.id===+id);if(cart[id]<p.stock)cart[id]++;save();renderCart();updateCartCount()})}
$("search").addEventListener("input",renderProducts);$("cartBtn").onclick=()=>{show("cartView");renderCart()};$("backShop").onclick=()=>show("shopView");$("backFromAdmin").onclick=()=>show("shopView");
$("settingsBtn").onclick=()=>{show("adminView");$("adminLogin").classList.remove("hidden");$("adminDashboard").classList.add("hidden");$("loginError").textContent="";$("adminPass").value=""};
$("pImage").onchange=async()=>{const file=$("pImage").files[0];if(!file){imageData="";return}if(!file.type.startsWith("image/")){toast("একটি JPG, PNG বা WebP ছবির ফাইল নির্বাচন করুন।");$("pImage").value="";return}try{toast("ছবি প্রস্তুত হচ্ছে…");const dataUrl=await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const reader=new FileReader();reader.onerror=()=>reject(new Error("read"));reader.onload=()=>resolve(reader.result);reader.readAsDataURL(file)});const img=await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const im=new Image();im.onload=()=>resolve(im);im.onerror=()=>reject(new Error("image"));im.src=dataUrl});const maxSide=700,scale=Math.min(1,maxSide/Math.max(img.naturalWidth,img.naturalHeight));const canvas=document.createElement("canvas");canvas.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(img.naturalWidth*scale));canvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(img.naturalHeight*scale));const ctx=canvas.getContext("2d");ctx.fillStyle="#ffffff";ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);ctx.drawImage(img,0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);imageData=canvas.toDataURL("image/jpeg",0.76);toast("ছবি আপলোডের জন্য প্রস্তুত। এখন পণ্য সেভ করুন।")}catch(e){imageData="";toast("ছবি পড়া যায়নি। অন্য JPG বা PNG ছবি চেষ্টা করুন।");$("pImage").value=""}};
function resetProductForm(){$("productForm").reset();$("editId").value="";imageData="";$("productFormTitle").textContent="➕ নতুন পণ্য যোগ করুন";$("saveProductBtn").textContent="পণ্য সেভ করুন";$("cancelEdit").classList.add("hidden")}
$("productForm").onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();let id=$("editId").value?+$("editId").value:Date.now(),old=products.find(p=>p.id===id),p={id,name:$("pName").value.trim(),category:$("pCategory").value.trim()||"অন্যান্য",price:Number($("pPrice").value),stock:Number($("pStock").value),desc:$("pDesc").value.trim(),emoji:old?.emoji||"📦",image:imageData||(old?.image||"")};if(!p.name||p.price<0||p.stock<0)return;if(old)products=products.map(x=>x.id===id?p:x);else products.unshift(p);if(!save())return;resetProductForm();renderAll();toast(old?"পণ্যের তথ্য আপডেট হয়েছে।":"নতুন পণ্য যোগ হয়েছে।")};
$("cancelEdit").onclick=resetProductForm;
function editProduct(id){let p=products.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!p)return;$("editId").value=p.id;$("pName").value=p.name;$("pCategory").value=p.category||"";$("pPrice").value=p.price;$("pStock").value=p.stock;$("pDesc").value=p.desc||"";$("pImage").value="";imageData="";$("productFormTitle").textContent="✏️ পণ্য এডিট করুন";$("saveProductBtn").textContent="পরিবর্তন সেভ করুন";$("cancelEdit").classList.remove("hidden");$("productFormTitle").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"})}
function renderAdmin(){$("statProducts").textContent=products.length;$("statOrders").textContent=orders.length;$("statStock").textContent=products.reduce((s,p)=>s+Number(p.stock||0),0);$("adminProducts").innerHTML=products.length?products.map(p=>`<div class="adminProduct" data-admin-order="${p.id}" role="button" tabindex="0" title="অর্ডার ফর্ম খুলতে চাপ দিন" style="cursor:pointer">${p.image?`<img src="${p.image}" alt="">`:`<div class="emoji">${p.emoji||"📦"}</div>`}<div><strong>${esc(p.name)}</strong><div class="muted">দাম: ${money(p.price)} · স্টক: ${p.stock}টি</div><div class="muted">${esc(p.category||"অন্যান্য")}</div></div><div class="adminButtons"><button class="secondary" data-edit="${p.id}">এডিট</button> <button class="danger" data-remove="${p.id}">মুছুন</button></div></div>`).join(""):`<div class="empty">এখনো কোনো পণ্য যোগ করা হয়নি। উপরের ফর্ম দিয়ে যোগ করুন।</div>`;$("adminProducts").querySelectorAll("[data-admin-order]").forEach(el=>{el.onclick=()=>openAdminOrder(+el.dataset.adminOrder);el.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==="Enter"||e.key===" "){e.preventDefault();openAdminOrder(+el.dataset.adminOrder)}};el.setAttribute("role","button");el.setAttribute("tabindex","0");el.style.cursor="pointer";});$("adminProducts").querySelectorAll("[data-edit],[data-remove]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=e=>e.stopPropagation());$("adminProducts").querySelectorAll("[data-edit]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=e=>{e.stopPropagation();editProduct(+b.dataset.edit)});$("adminProducts").querySelectorAll("[data-remove]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{let id=+b.dataset.remove;if(confirm("পণ্যটি মুছবেন?")){products=products.filter(p=>p.id!==id);delete cart[id];save();renderAll();toast("পণ্য মুছে ফেলা হয়েছে।")}});$("ordersList").innerHTML=orders.length?orders.map((o,index)=>{let st=o.status||"Pending";return `<div class="order"><div class="orderhead"><strong>অর্ডার ${index+1} · #${esc(o.id)}</strong><span class="badge">${esc(st)}</span></div><p class="muted">${esc(o.date||"")}</p><p><strong>গ্রাহক:</strong> ${esc(o.customer)} · <strong>মোবাইল:</strong> ${esc(o.phone)}</p><p><strong>সম্পূর্ণ ঠিকানা:</strong> ${esc(o.address)}</p><p><strong>পণ্য:</strong> ${o.items.map(i=>`${esc(i.name)} × ${i.qty}`).join(", ")}</p><p><strong>মোট:</strong> ${money(o.total)} · ${esc(o.payment)}</p><div class="row"><button class="order-status ${st==='Pending'?'active':''}" data-status="Pending" data-id="${esc(o.id)}">Pending</button><button class="order-status ${st==='Cancel'?'active':''}" data-status="Cancel" data-id="${esc(o.id)}">Cancel</button><button class="order-status ${st==='Confirm'?'active':''}" data-status="Confirm" data-id="${esc(o.id)}">Confirm</button><button class="remove-order" data-remove-order="${esc(o.id)}">Remove</button></div></div>`}).join(""):`<div class="empty">এখনো কোনো অর্ডার নেই।</div>`;$("ordersList").querySelectorAll("[data-status]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>changeOrderStatus(b.dataset.id,b.dataset.status));$("ordersList").querySelectorAll("[data-remove-order]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>removeOrder(b.dataset.removeOrder));}
function changeOrderStatus(id,nextStatus){const o=orders.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!o)return;const previous=o.status||"Pending";if(previous===nextStatus){toast("এই অর্ডারটি ইতিমধ্যে "+nextStatus+" আছে।");return}if(!confirm(`অর্ডার #${id} এর স্ট্যাটাস ${nextStatus} করবেন?\n\nআগের স্ট্যাটাস: ${previous}\n\nOK চাপলে পরিবর্তন হবে, Cancel চাপলে আগের মতো থাকবে।`))return;o.status=nextStatus;save();renderAdmin();toast("অর্ডারের স্ট্যাটাস "+nextStatus+" করা হয়েছে।")}
function removeOrder(id){const o=orders.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!o)return;if(!confirm(`অর্ডার #${id} তালিকা থেকে স্থায়ীভাবে Remove করবেন?\n\nOK চাপলে অর্ডার মুছে যাবে, Cancel চাপলে থাকবে।`))return;orders=orders.filter(x=>x.id!==id);save();renderAdmin();toast("অর্ডার Remove করা হয়েছে।")}

function openAdminOrder(id){const p=products.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!p)return;if(p.stock<=0){toast("এই পণ্যের স্টক শেষ।");return}adminOrderProductId=id;["timerDays","timerHours","timerMinutes","timerSeconds"].forEach(k=>$(k).value=0);$("adminOrderPanel").classList.remove("hidden");$("adminOrderProduct").innerHTML=`<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px">${p.image?`<img src="${p.image}" alt="${esc(p.name)}" style="width:84px;height:84px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:12px">`:`<div class="customer-avatar">${p.emoji||"📦"}</div>`}<div><strong>${esc(p.name)}</strong><br>দাম: ${money(p.price)} · স্টকে আছে: ${p.stock}টি<br><span class="small-muted">➕ ${currentLang==="bn"?"এই পণ্যের অর্ডার যোগ করুন":"Add an order for this product"}</span></div></div>`;$("adminQty").max=p.stock;$("adminQty").value=1;$("adminOrderTotal").textContent="মোট: "+money(p.price);$("adminCustomer").focus({preventScroll:true})}
$("adminQty").addEventListener("input",()=>{const p=products.find(x=>x.id===adminOrderProductId);if(p){let q=Math.max(1,Number($("adminQty").value)||1);$("adminOrderTotal").textContent="মোট: "+money(p.price*q)}});
$("closeAdminOrder").onclick=()=>{$("adminOrderPanel").classList.add("hidden");$("adminOrderForm").reset();adminOrderProductId=null};
$("adminOrderForm").onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();const p=products.find(x=>x.id===adminOrderProductId),qty=Number($("adminQty").value);if(!p||qty<1||qty>p.stock){toast("পরিমাণ স্টকের মধ্যে দিন।");return}const item={id:p.id,name:p.name,price:p.price,qty};const order={id:"HM"+Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase()+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6).toUpperCase(),transactionId:uniqueTx(),createdAt:Date.now(),source:"admin",date:new Date().toLocaleString("bn-BD"),customer:$("adminCustomer").value.trim(),username:$("adminUsername").value.trim(),phone:$("adminPhone").value.trim(),address:$("adminAddress").value.trim(),payment:$("adminPayment").value,items:[item],total:p.price*qty,status:"Pending",endAt:Date.now()+((Number($("timerDays").value)||0)*86400+(Number($("timerHours").value)||0)*3600+(Number($("timerMinutes").value)||0)*60+(Number($("timerSeconds").value)||0))*1000};if(order.endAt<=Date.now())delete order.endAt;p.stock-=qty;orders.unshift(order);save();$("adminOrderForm").reset();$("adminOrderPanel").classList.add("hidden");adminOrderProductId=null;renderAll();toast("অর্ডার লিস্টে যোগ হয়েছে: "+order.id);};
function renderAll(){renderCategories();renderProducts();updateCartCount();if(!$("adminDashboard").classList.contains("hidden"))renderAdmin()}
$("loginForm").onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();if($("adminPass").value===ADMIN_PASSWORD){$("adminLogin").classList.add("hidden");$("adminDashboard").classList.remove("hidden");renderAdmin()}else $("loginError").textContent="পাসওয়ার্ড সঠিক নয়।"};
$("checkoutForm").onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();let ids=Object.keys(cart).filter(id=>cart[id]>0);if(!ids.length)return;for(let id of ids){let p=products.find(x=>x.id===+id);if(!p||cart[id]>p.stock){toast("একটি পণ্যের স্টক পরিবর্তন হয়েছে। কার্ট আপডেট করুন।");renderCart();return}}let items=ids.map(id=>{let p=products.find(x=>x.id===+id);return{id:p.id,name:p.name,price:p.price,qty:cart[id]}});let order={id:"HM"+Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase()+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6).toUpperCase(),transactionId:uniqueTx(),createdAt:Date.now(),date:new Date().toLocaleString("bn-BD"),customer:$("customerName").value.trim(),username:(accountGet()?.username||accountGet()?.email||$("customerName").value.trim()),phone:$("phone").value.trim(),address:$("address").value.trim(),payment:$("payment").value,items,total:items.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.price*x.qty,0),status:"Pending"};items.forEach(i=>{let p=products.find(x=>x.id===i.id);p.stock-=i.qty});orders.unshift(order);cart={};save();$("checkoutForm").reset();renderAll();show("shopView");toast("অর্ডার হয়েছে! নম্বর: "+order.id)};
$("exportOrders").onclick=()=>downloadJSON(orders,"hexamart-orders.json");function downloadJSON(data,name){let blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(data,null,2)],{type:"application/json"}),url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement("a");a.href=url;a.download=name;a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000)}
$("saveSettings").onclick=()=>{let name=$("storeName").value.trim()||"HexaMart";document.title=name+" — Online Shop";$("productsTitle").textContent=name+" পণ্যসমূহ";toast("শপের নাম আপডেট হয়েছে।")};$("logout").onclick=()=>{$("adminDashboard").classList.add("hidden");$("adminLogin").classList.remove("hidden");$("adminPass").value=""};
function renderAdmin(){
 $("statProducts").textContent=products.length;$("statOrders").textContent=orders.length;$("statStock").textContent=products.reduce((s,p)=>s+Number(p.stock||0),0);
 $("adminProducts").innerHTML=products.length?products.map(p=>`<div class="adminProduct" data-admin-order="${p.id}" role="button" tabindex="0" title="পণ্যে চাপ দিয়ে অর্ডার যোগ করুন" style="cursor:pointer">${p.image?`<img src="${p.image}" alt="">`:`<div class="emoji">${p.emoji||"📦"}</div>`}<div><strong>${esc(p.name)}</strong><div class="muted">দাম: ${money(p.price)} · স্টক: ${p.stock}টি</div><div class="muted">${esc(p.category||"অন্যান্য")}</div><div class="small-muted">➕ গ্রাহকের অর্ডার যোগ করুন</div></div><div class="adminButtons"><button class="secondary" data-edit="${p.id}">এডিট</button> <button class="danger" data-remove="${p.id}">মুছুন</button></div></div>`).join(""):`<div class="empty">এখনো কোনো পণ্য যোগ করা হয়নি।</div>`;
 $("adminProducts").querySelectorAll("[data-admin-order]").forEach(el=>{el.onclick=null;el.onkeydown=null;el.removeAttribute("role");el.removeAttribute("tabindex");el.style.cursor="default";});$("adminProducts").querySelectorAll("[data-edit],[data-remove]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=e=>e.stopPropagation());$("adminProducts").querySelectorAll("[data-edit]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=e=>{e.stopPropagation();editProduct(+b.dataset.edit)});$("adminProducts").querySelectorAll("[data-remove]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{let id=+b.dataset.remove;if(confirm("পণ্যটি মুছবেন?")){products=products.filter(p=>p.id!==id);delete cart[id];save();renderAll();toast("পণ্য মুছে ফেলা হয়েছে।")}});
 $("ordersHeading").textContent=currentLang==="bn"?`🧾 গ্রাহকের তালিকা (${orders.length} গ্রাহক)`: `🧾 Customer list (${orders.length} customers)`;
 $("ordersList").innerHTML=orders.length?orders.map((o,index)=>{let st=o.status||"Pending",item=(o.items||[])[0]||{},p=products.find(x=>x.id===item.id),img=p?.image||"";return `<div class="customer-card" data-open-order="${esc(o.id)}"><div class="customer-avatar">${img?`<img src="${img}" alt="" style="width:44px;height:44px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:50%">`:"👤"}</div><div class="customer-main"><strong>${index+1}. ${esc(o.username||o.customer||"Customer")}</strong><div class="muted">${esc(o.phone||"")} · ${esc(item.name||"Order")}</div><div class="small-muted">${currentLang==="bn"?"অর্ডার":"Order"} #${esc(o.id)}</div></div><span class="badge">${esc(st)}</span></div>`}).join(""):`<div class="empty">${currentLang==="bn"?"এখনো কোনো গ্রাহকের অর্ডার নেই।":"No customer orders yet."}</div>`;
 $("ordersList").querySelectorAll("[data-open-order]").forEach(el=>el.onclick=()=>showOrderDetail(el.dataset.openOrder));if(selectedOrderId&&orders.some(o=>o.id===selectedOrderId))showOrderDetail(selectedOrderId);else $("orderDetail").classList.add("hidden");
}
function showOrderDetail(id){const o=orders.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!o)return;selectedOrderId=id;const st=o.status||"Pending",items=o.items||[],bn=currentLang==="bn",timer=o.endAt?`<p><strong>${bn?"কাউন্টডাউন":"Countdown"}:</strong> <span class="timer-chip" data-countdown="${esc(o.id)}">${formatCountdown(Math.max(0,o.endAt-Date.now()))}</span></p>`:"";$("orderDetail").classList.remove("hidden");$("orderDetail").innerHTML=`<div class="sectionhead"><h3>${bn?"গ্রাহকের বিস্তারিত":"Customer details"}</h3><button class="secondary" id="closeOrderDetail">✕</button></div><p><strong>${bn?"অর্ডার":"Order"} #${esc(o.id)}</strong> · <span class="badge">${esc(st)}</span></p><p class="small-muted">${esc(o.date||"")}</p><p><strong>${bn?"ইউজারনেম":"Username"}:</strong> ${esc(o.username||o.customer||"Customer")}</p><p><strong>${bn?"নাম":"Name"}:</strong> ${esc(o.customer)}</p><p><strong>${bn?"মোবাইল":"Mobile"}:</strong> <a href="tel:${esc(o.phone)}">${esc(o.phone)}</a></p><p><strong>${bn?"ঠিকানা":"Address"}:</strong> ${esc(o.address)}</p><h4>${bn?"পণ্য":"Products"}</h4>${items.map(i=>{let p=products.find(x=>x.id===i.id);return `<div class="itemrow">${p?.image?`<img src="${p.image}" alt="" style="width:66px;height:66px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:10px">`:`<div class="customer-avatar">📦</div>`}<div class="itemgrow"><strong>${esc(i.name)}</strong><div>${money(i.price)} × ${i.qty}</div></div></div>`}).join("")}<p><strong>${bn?"মোট":"Total"}:</strong> ${money(o.total)}</p><p><strong>${bn?"পেমেন্ট":"Payment"}:</strong> ${esc(o.payment||"")}</p>${timer}<div class="row"><button class="order-status ${st==='Confirm'?'active':''}" id="detailConfirm">${bn?"কনফার্ম":"Confirm"}</button><button class="order-status ${st==='Cancel'?'active':''}" id="detailCancel">${bn?"বাতিল":"Cancel"}</button><button class="danger" id="detailRemove">Remove</button></div>`;$("closeOrderDetail").onclick=()=>{$("orderDetail").classList.add("hidden");selectedOrderId=null};$("detailConfirm").onclick=()=>changeOrderStatus(o.id,"Confirm");$("detailCancel").onclick=()=>changeOrderStatus(o.id,"Cancel");$("detailRemove").onclick=()=>removeOrder(o.id);$("orderDetail").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"nearest"})}
function formatCountdown(ms){let s=Math.max(0,Math.floor(ms/1000)),d=Math.floor(s/86400);s%=86400;let h=Math.floor(s/3600);s%=3600;let m=Math.floor(s/60);s%=60;return `${d}d ${String(h).padStart(2,"0")}:${String(m).padStart(2,"0")}:${String(s).padStart(2,"0")}`}
function countdownTick(){let changed=false;orders.forEach(o=>{if(o.endAt&&o.status==="Pending"&&Date.now()>=o.endAt){o.status="Confirm";o.autoConfirmed=true;changed=true}});if(changed){save();renderAdmin();toast(currentLang==="bn"?"সময় শেষ—অর্ডার স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে কনফার্ম হয়েছে।":"Timer ended — order auto-confirmed.")}document.querySelectorAll("[data-countdown]").forEach(el=>{let o=orders.find(x=>x.id===el.dataset.countdown);if(o?.endAt)el.textContent=formatCountdown(Math.max(0,o.endAt-Date.now()))})}
function openLanguage(){show("languageView");$("chooseBn").classList.toggle("active",currentLang==="bn");$("chooseEn").classList.toggle("active",currentLang==="en")}
function setLanguage(lang){currentLang=lang;localStorage.setItem("hexamart_lang",lang);applyLanguage();show("adminView");renderAdmin();toast(lang==="bn"?"ভাষা বাংলা করা হয়েছে।":"Language set to English.")}
function applyLanguage(){let bn=currentLang==="bn";document.documentElement.lang=currentLang;document.title=bn?"HexaMart — অনলাইন শপ":"HexaMart — Online Shop";const pairs={backFromAdmin:bn?"← শপে ফিরুন":"← Back to shop",openLanguage:bn?"🌐 ভাষা":"🌐 Language",saveSettings:bn?"সেটিংস সেভ":"Save settings",logout:bn?"লগআউট":"Log out",closeLanguage:bn?"← ফিরে যান":"← Back",exportOrders:bn?"অর্ডার ডাউনলোড":"Export orders"};Object.entries(pairs).forEach(([id,v])=>{if($(id))$(id).textContent=v});document.querySelectorAll("[data-i18n]").forEach(el=>{let d={timerLabel:["অর্ডার কনফার্ম হওয়ার কাউন্টডাউন (ঐচ্ছিক)","Order confirmation countdown (optional)"],days:["দিন","Days"],hours:["ঘণ্টা","Hours"],minutes:["মিনিট","Minutes"],seconds:["সেকেন্ড","Seconds"],timerHelp:["সময় ০ রাখলে কাউন্টডাউন হবে না। সময় শেষ হলে Pending অর্ডার নিজে থেকে Confirm হবে।","Set all fields to 0 for no countdown. Pending orders auto-confirm when time ends."],addOrder:["অর্ডার লিস্টে যোগ করুন","Add to order list"],language:["Language / ভাষা","Language"],languageTitle:["🌐 ভাষা নির্বাচন","🌐 Choose language"],languageHelp:["ভাষা বেছে নিলে ইন্টারফেসের লেখা বদলাবে।","Choose a language for the interface."]}[el.dataset.i18n];if(d)el.textContent=d[bn?0:1]});const labels={pName:bn?'পণ্যের নাম *':'Product name *',pCategory:bn?'ক্যাটাগরি':'Category',pPrice:bn?'দাম (৳) *':'Price (৳) *',pStock:bn?'স্টক (কতটি আছে) *':'Stock quantity *',pDesc:bn?'বর্ণনা':'Description',pImage:bn?'পণ্যের ছবি':'Product image',adminCustomer:bn?'গ্রাহকের নাম *':'Customer name *',adminPhone:bn?'মোবাইল নম্বর *':'Mobile number *',adminAddress:bn?'সম্পূর্ণ ডেলিভারি ঠিকানা *':'Full delivery address *',adminQty:bn?'পরিমাণ *':'Quantity *',adminPayment:bn?'পেমেন্ট পদ্ধতি':'Payment method',customerName:bn?'আপনার নাম':'Your name',phone:bn?'মোবাইল নম্বর':'Mobile number',address:bn?'সম্পূর্ণ ঠিকানা':'Full address',payment:bn?'পেমেন্ট পদ্ধতি':'Payment method'};Object.entries(labels).forEach(([id,v])=>{document.querySelectorAll(`label[for="${id}"]`).forEach(el=>el.textContent=v)});const ph={search:bn?'পণ্যের নাম লিখে খুঁজুন...':'Search products...',pName:bn?'যেমন: Wireless Headphones':'e.g. Wireless Headphones',pCategory:bn?'যেমন: ইলেকট্রনিক্স':'e.g. Electronics',adminCustomer:bn?'সম্পূর্ণ নাম':'Full name',adminPhone:bn?'01XXXXXXXXX':'Phone number',adminAddress:bn?'বাসা, রোড, এলাকা, জেলা':'House, road, area, city'};Object.entries(ph).forEach(([id,v])=>{if($(id))$(id).placeholder=v});}
$('openLanguage').onclick=openLanguage;$('closeLanguage').onclick=()=>show('adminView');$('chooseBn').onclick=()=>setLanguage('bn');$('chooseEn').onclick=()=>setLanguage('en');

// --- Account registration/login, dedicated settings screen, product-specific order screen ---
const _originalShow=show;
show=function(view){["shopView","cartView","adminView","languageView","settingsView","accountView"].forEach(id=>{if($(id))$(id).classList.toggle("hidden",id!==view)});window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:"smooth"});};
// Settings button opens a separate settings screen, not admin directly.
$("settingsBtn").onclick=()=>{show("settingsView");};
$("closeSettings").onclick=()=>show("shopView");
$("settingsLanguage").onclick=()=>openLanguage();
$("settingsAdmin").onclick=()=>{show("adminView");$("adminLogin").classList.remove("hidden");$("adminDashboard").classList.add("hidden");$("loginError").textContent="";$("adminPass").value="";};
$("closeLanguage").onclick=()=>show("settingsView");
const accountGet=()=>{try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("hexamart_account")||"null")}catch{return null}};
const accountSession=()=>localStorage.getItem("hexamart_logged_in")==="yes";
function accountGate(){if(!accountSession()){show("accountView");$("registerPane").classList.toggle("hidden",!!accountGet());$("accountLoginPane").classList.toggle("hidden",!accountGet());}else show("shopView");}
$("registerForm").onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();const username=$("regUsername").value.trim().replace(/\s+/g,""),name=$("regName").value.trim(),email=$("regEmail").value.trim().toLowerCase(),password=$("regPassword").value;if(username.length<3){toast(currentLang==="bn"?"ইউজারনেম অন্তত ৩ অক্ষরের দিন।":"Username must be at least 3 characters.");return}if(password.length<6){toast(currentLang==="bn"?"পাসওয়ার্ড অন্তত ৬ অক্ষরের দিন।":"Use a password of at least 6 characters.");return}localStorage.setItem("hexamart_account",JSON.stringify({username,name,email,password}));const plearKey="hexamart_registered_users";let plearUsers=[];try{plearUsers=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(plearKey)||"[]");if(!Array.isArray(plearUsers))plearUsers=[];}catch(_){plearUsers=[];}const plearRecord={username,name,email,registeredAt:Date.now()};const existingPlearIndex=plearUsers.findIndex(u=>String(u.email||"").toLowerCase()===email||String(u.username||"").toLowerCase()===username.toLowerCase());if(existingPlearIndex>=0)plearUsers[existingPlearIndex]={...plearUsers[existingPlearIndex],...plearRecord};else plearUsers.unshift(plearRecord);localStorage.setItem(plearKey,JSON.stringify(plearUsers));$("loginEmail").value=email;$("registerPane").classList.add("hidden");$("accountLoginPane").classList.remove("hidden");toast(currentLang==="bn"?"রেজিস্ট্রেশন হয়েছে। এবার ইমেইল ও পাসওয়ার্ড দিয়ে লগইন করুন।":"Registered. Now log in with your email and password.");};
$("showLogin").onclick=()=>{$("registerPane").classList.add("hidden");$("accountLoginPane").classList.remove("hidden");};
$("showRegister").onclick=()=>{$("accountLoginPane").classList.add("hidden");$("registerPane").classList.remove("hidden");};
$("accountLoginForm").onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();const a=accountGet();if(a&&a.email===$("loginEmail").value.trim().toLowerCase()&&a.password===$("loginPassword").value){localStorage.setItem("hexamart_logged_in","yes");$("accountError").textContent="";show("shopView");toast(currentLang==="bn"?"লগইন সফল হয়েছে।":"Login successful.");}else $("accountError").textContent=currentLang==="bn"?"ইমেইল অথবা পাসওয়ার্ড সঠিক নয়।":"Incorrect email or password.";};
$("accountLogout").onclick=()=>{localStorage.removeItem("hexamart_logged_in");$("loginPassword").value="";accountGate();};
// Make the selected product's customer/order form a separate full-screen interface.
const _oldOpenAdminOrder=openAdminOrder;
openAdminOrder=function(id){_oldOpenAdminOrder(id);const panel=$("adminOrderPanel");if(!panel.classList.contains("hidden")){panel.classList.add("product-order-screen");panel.scrollTop=0;}};
$("closeAdminOrder").onclick=()=>{$("adminOrderPanel").classList.add("hidden");$("adminOrderPanel").classList.remove("product-order-screen");adminOrderProductId=null;};
