// Admin workspace: two clear tabs. Customer records are grouped inside each product.
let customerManagerProductId=null,customerManagerOrderId=null;
function setAdminTab(which){
 const productsOn=which==="products",customersOn=which==="customers",historyOn=which==="history",plearOn=which==="plear";
 // Keep the workspace parent visible; only the selected screen is shown.
 $("adminProductsWorkspace").classList.remove("hidden");
 $("productManagementWorkspace").classList.toggle("hidden",!productsOn);
 $("adminCustomerManager").classList.toggle("hidden",!customersOn);
 $("ordersWorkspace").classList.toggle("hidden",!historyOn);
 $("historyWorkspace").classList.toggle("hidden",!historyOn);
 $("plearWorkspace").classList.toggle("hidden",!plearOn);
 [ ["tabProducts",productsOn],["tabCustomers",customersOn],["tabHistory",historyOn],["tabPlear",plearOn] ].forEach(([id,on])=>{$(id).classList.toggle("secondary",!on);$(id).classList.toggle("tab-active",on)});
 if(customersOn){renderCustomerProductList();}
 if(historyOn){renderAdmin();}
 if(plearOn){renderPlearUsers();}
 updateNewOrderBadge();
}

function updateNewOrderBadge(){const n=orders.filter(o=>(o.status||"Pending")==="Pending"&&(o.source==="customer"||o.source==="online")).length;const b=$("newOrderBadge");if(!b)return;b.textContent=n?`নতুন ${n}`:"";b.classList.toggle("hidden",!n);}

function renderCustomerProductList(){customerManagerProductId=null;customerManagerOrderId=null;$("customerBack").classList.add("hidden");$("customerManagerTitle").textContent=currentLang==="bn"?"👥 গ্রাহক — পণ্য নির্বাচন করুন":"👥 Customers — Select a product";$("productCustomersList").classList.add("hidden");$("singleCustomerDetail").classList.add("hidden");$("customerProductsList").classList.remove("hidden");$("customerProductsList").innerHTML=products.length?products.map(p=>{let count=orders.filter(o=>(o.items||[]).some(i=>String(i.id)===String(p.id))).length;return `<div class="customer-card" data-customer-product="${p.id}"><div class="customer-avatar">${p.image?`<img src="${p.image}" alt="" style="width:44px;height:44px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:50%">`:(p.emoji||"📦")}</div><div class="customer-main"><strong>${esc(p.name)}</strong><div class="muted">${money(p.price)} · ${count} ${currentLang==="bn"?"গ্রাহক":"customers"}</div></div><span>›</span></div>`}).join(""):`<div class="empty">${currentLang==="bn"?"আগে পণ্য যোগ করুন।":"Add products first."}</div>`;$("customerProductsList").querySelectorAll("[data-customer-product]").forEach(el=>el.onclick=()=>renderProductCustomerList(+el.dataset.customerProduct));}
function renderProductCustomerList(pid){const p=products.find(x=>x.id===pid);if(!p)return;customerManagerProductId=pid;$("singleCustomerDetail").classList.add("hidden");$("customerBack").classList.remove("hidden");$("customerManagerTitle").textContent=p.name;$("customerProductsList").classList.add("hidden");$("singleCustomerDetail").classList.add("hidden");$("productCustomersList").classList.remove("hidden");const related=orders.filter(o=>(o.items||[]).some(i=>String(i.id)===String(pid)));$("productCustomersList").innerHTML=`<div class="notice" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px">${p.image?`<img src="${p.image}" alt="" style="width:72px;height:72px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:10px">`:`<span style="font-size:40px">${p.emoji||"📦"}</span>`}<div><strong>${esc(p.name)}</strong><div>${money(p.price)}</div><div>${related.length} ${currentLang==="bn"?"গ্রাহক":"customers"}</div></div></div><button type="button" id="addCustomerToProduct" style="width:100%;margin:8px 0">＋ ${currentLang==="bn"?"এই পণ্যে গ্রাহকের তথ্য যোগ করুন":"Add customer to this product"}</button><div id="productCustomerRows">${related.length?related.map((o,i)=>`<div class="customer-card" data-customer-order="${esc(o.id)}"><div class="customer-avatar">👤</div><div class="customer-main"><strong>${i+1}. ${esc(o.username||o.customer||"Customer")}</strong><div class="muted">${esc(o.status||"Pending")} · ${esc(o.date||"")}</div></div><span>›</span></div>`).join(""):`<div class="empty">${currentLang==="bn"?"এই পণ্যে এখনো গ্রাহক যোগ হয়নি।":"No customers for this product yet."}</div>`}</div>`;$("addCustomerToProduct").onclick=()=>openAdminOrder(pid);$("productCustomerRows").querySelectorAll("[data-customer-order]").forEach(el=>el.onclick=()=>renderSingleCustomer(el.dataset.customerOrder));}
function renderSingleCustomer(oid){const o=orders.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(oid));if(!o)return;customerManagerOrderId=oid;const bn=currentLang==="bn",items=o.items||[];$("customerProductsList").classList.add("hidden");$("productCustomersList").classList.add("hidden");$("singleCustomerDetail").classList.remove("hidden");$("singleCustomerDetail").innerHTML=`<div class="customer-detail"><div class="sectionhead"><h3>${bn?"গ্রাহকের সম্পূর্ণ তথ্য":"Full customer details"}</h3><button class="secondary" id="customerDetailBack">← ${bn?"ফিরে যান":"Back"}</button></div><p><strong>${bn?"ইউজারনেম":"Username"}:</strong> ${esc(o.username||o.customer||"Customer")}</p><p><strong>${bn?"নাম":"Name"}:</strong> ${esc(o.customer||"")}</p><p><strong>${bn?"মোবাইল":"Mobile"}:</strong> ${esc(o.phone||"")}</p><p><strong>${bn?"ঠিকানা":"Address"}:</strong> ${esc(o.address||"")}</p><p><strong>${bn?"পণ্য":"Product"}:</strong> ${items.map(i=>esc(i.name)+" × "+i.qty).join(", ")}</p><p><strong>${bn?"মোট":"Total"}:</strong> ${money(o.total)}</p><p><strong>${bn?"পেমেন্ট":"Payment"}:</strong> ${esc(o.payment||"")}</p><p><strong>${bn?"স্ট্যাটাস":"Status"}:</strong> ${esc(o.status||"Pending")}</p><div class="row"><button class="order-status ${(o.status||"Pending")==="Pending"?"active":""}" id="cmPending">Pending</button><button class="order-status ${o.status==="Confirm"?"active":""}" id="cmConfirm">Confirm</button><button class="order-status ${o.status==="Cancel"?"active":""}" id="cmCancel">Cancel</button><button class="remove-order" id="cmRemove">Remove</button></div></div>`;$("customerDetailBack").onclick=()=>renderProductCustomerList(customerManagerProductId);$("cmPending").onclick=()=>{changeOrderStatus(o.id,"Pending");renderSingleCustomer(o.id)};$("cmConfirm").onclick=()=>{changeOrderStatus(o.id,"Confirm");renderSingleCustomer(o.id)};$("cmCancel").onclick=()=>{changeOrderStatus(o.id,"Cancel");renderSingleCustomer(o.id)};$("cmRemove").onclick=()=>{removeOrder(o.id);renderProductCustomerList(customerManagerProductId)};}
function renderPlearUsers(){let users=[];try{users=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("hexamart_registered_users")||"[]");if(!Array.isArray(users))users=[];}catch(_){users=[];}const q=($("plearSearch")?.value||"").trim().toLowerCase();const filtered=users.filter(u=>[u.name,u.username,u.email].some(v=>String(v||"").toLowerCase().includes(q)));$("plearCount").textContent=users.length+" জন";$("plearList").innerHTML=filtered.length?[...filtered].sort((a,b)=>(b.registeredAt||0)-(a.registeredAt||0)).map((u,i)=>`<div class="customer-card"><div class="customer-avatar">👤</div><div class="customer-main"><strong>${esc(u.name||"নাম দেওয়া হয়নি")}</strong><div class="muted">ইউজারনেম: ${esc(u.username||"—")}</div><div class="muted">ইমেইল: ${esc(u.email||"—")}</div><div class="small-muted">রেজিস্ট্রেশন: ${esc(u.registeredAt?new Date(u.registeredAt).toLocaleString("bn-BD",{dateStyle:"medium",timeStyle:"medium"}):"—")}</div></div></div>`).join(""):`<div class="empty">${users.length?"কোনো মিল পাওয়া যায়নি।":"এখনো কোনো রেজিস্ট্রেশন নেই।"}</div>`;}$("plearSearch").addEventListener("input",renderPlearUsers);$("tabProducts").onclick=()=>setAdminTab("products");$("tabCustomers").onclick=()=>setAdminTab("customers");$("tabHistory").onclick=()=>setAdminTab("history");$("tabPlear").onclick=()=>setAdminTab("plear");$("customerBack").onclick=()=>renderCustomerProductList();
const _oldRenderAdminForCustomerTabs=renderAdmin;renderAdmin=function(){_oldRenderAdminForCustomerTabs();updateNewOrderBadge();if(!$("adminCustomerManager").classList.contains("hidden")){const keepProduct=customerManagerProductId;if(keepProduct&&products.some(p=>p.id===keepProduct))renderProductCustomerList(keepProduct);else renderCustomerProductList();}};
// Language screen returns to settings; apply labels to account/settings controls too.
const _oldSetLanguage=setLanguage;
setLanguage=function(lang){currentLang=lang;localStorage.setItem("hexamart_lang",lang);applyLanguage();show("settingsView");renderAdmin();toast(lang==="bn"?"ভাষা বাংলা করা হয়েছে।":"Language set to English.");};
const _oldApplyLanguage=applyLanguage;
applyLanguage=function(){_oldApplyLanguage();const bn=currentLang==="bn";const labels={settingsTitle:bn?"⚙ সেটিংস":"⚙ Settings",adminPanelLabel:bn?"🔐 অ্যাডমিন প্যানেল":"🔐 Admin panel",accountLabel:bn?"👤 অ্যাকাউন্ট":"👤 Account",logoutAccount:bn?"লগআউট":"Log out",registerTitle:bn?"অ্যাকাউন্ট খুলুন":"Create account",fullName:bn?"আপনার নাম":"Your name",email:bn?"ইমেইল":"Email",password:bn?"পাসওয়ার্ড":"Password",registerBtn:bn?"রেজিস্টার":"Register",alreadyAccount:bn?"আগে অ্যাকাউন্ট আছে?":"Already have an account?",loginTitle:bn?"লগইন করুন":"Log in",loginBtn:bn?"লগইন":"Log in",needAccount:bn?"অ্যাকাউন্ট নেই?":"No account?",localAccountNote:bn?"এই ডেমোতে অ্যাকাউন্ট এই ব্রাউজারে সংরক্ষিত হয়।":"Demo accounts are stored in this browser only."};document.querySelectorAll("[data-i18n]").forEach(el=>{const k=el.dataset.i18n;if(labels[k])el.textContent=labels[k];});if($("accountHeading"))$("accountHeading").textContent=bn?"HexaMart অ্যাকাউন্ট":"HexaMart Account";};
// Start with register/login. After the first successful login the shop opens.
applyLanguage();accountGate();


// Transaction IDs, timestamped status history, admin-wide history, and customer order lookup.
(function(){
 const txNow=()=>new Date().toISOString();
 function uniqueTx(){let id;do{id='HMTX-'+Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase()+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8).toUpperCase()}while(orders.some(o=>o.transactionId===id));return id;}
 function ensureOrderMetadata(o){if(!o.createdAt)o.createdAt=Date.parse(o.date)||Date.now();if(!o.transactionId)o.transactionId=uniqueTx();if(!Array.isArray(o.history))o.history=[{status:o.status||'Pending',at:o.createdAt,by:'System',note:'Order created'}];if((o.status||'Pending')==='Confirm'&&!o.confirmedAt)o.confirmedAt=o.createdAt;}
 orders.forEach(ensureOrderMetadata);save();
 const oldShowWithTracking=show;
 show=function(view){['shopView','cartView','adminView','languageView','settingsView','accountView','trackingView'].forEach(id=>{if($(id))$(id).classList.toggle('hidden',id!==view)});window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});};
 const myOrdersBtn=$('myOrdersBtn'); if(myOrdersBtn)myOrdersBtn.onclick=()=>{show('trackingView');$('trackingCode').value='';$('trackingResult').innerHTML='';};
 $('closeTracking').onclick=()=>show('shopView');
 const oldCheckoutSubmit=$('checkoutForm').onsubmit;
 $('checkoutForm').onsubmit=function(e){const before=new Set(orders.map(o=>o.id));if(oldCheckoutSubmit)oldCheckoutSubmit.call(this,e);const o=orders.find(x=>!before.has(x.id));if(o){ensureOrderMetadata(o);o.source='customer';o.createdAt=Date.now();o.history=[{status:'Pending',at:o.createdAt,by:o.username||o.customer||'Customer',note:'Order placed'}];o.status='Pending';save();toast((currentLang==='bn'?'ট্রানজেকশন আইডি: ':'Transaction ID: ')+o.transactionId);}};
 const oldAdminSubmit=$('adminOrderForm').onsubmit;
 $('adminOrderForm').onsubmit=function(e){const before=new Set(orders.map(o=>o.id));if(oldAdminSubmit)oldAdminSubmit.call(this,e);const o=orders.find(x=>!before.has(x.id));if(o){ensureOrderMetadata(o);o.createdAt=Date.now();o.history=[{status:'Pending',at:o.createdAt,by:'Admin',note:'Added by admin'}];o.status='Pending';save();}};
 const oldChangeStatus=changeOrderStatus;
 changeOrderStatus=function(id,next){const o=orders.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id));if(!o)return;const prev=o.status||'Pending';oldChangeStatus(id,next);if(o.status===next&&prev!==next){const at=Date.now();o.history=o.history||[];o.history.push({status:next,at,by:'Admin',note:next==='Confirm'?'Order confirmed':next==='Cancel'?'Order cancelled':'Status changed'});if(next==='Confirm')o.confirmedAt=at;else if(next==='Pending')delete o.confirmedAt;save();renderAdmin();}};
 const oldCountdownTick=countdownTick;
 countdownTick=function(){const before=new Map(orders.map(o=>[o.id,o.status]));oldCountdownTick();orders.forEach(o=>{if(before.get(o.id)==='Pending'&&o.status==='Confirm'){const at=Date.now();o.confirmedAt=at;o.history=o.history||[];o.history.push({status:'Confirm',at,by:'System',note:'Countdown finished; auto-confirmed'});}});if(orders.some(o=>before.get(o.id)!==o.status))save();};
 function fmtStamp(t){if(!t)return '—';try{return new Date(Number(t)).toLocaleString(currentLang==='bn'?'bn-BD':'en-GB',{year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',second:'2-digit',hour12:true})}catch{return String(t)}}
 function elapsed(t){let s=Math.max(0,Math.floor((Date.now()-Number(t||Date.now()))/1000)),d=Math.floor(s/86400);s%=86400;let h=Math.floor(s/3600);s%=3600;let m=Math.floor(s/60);s%=60;return `${d} ${currentLang==='bn'?'দিন':'days'} ${String(h).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(s).padStart(2,'0')}`}
 $('trackingForm').onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();const code=$('trackingCode').value.trim().toUpperCase();const o=orders.find(x=>String(x.transactionId||'').toUpperCase()===code);const bn=currentLang==='bn';if(!o){$('trackingResult').innerHTML=`<div class="notice">${bn?'এই ট্রানজেকশন আইডিতে কোনো অর্ডার পাওয়া যায়নি।':'No order found for this transaction ID.'}</div>`;return;}ensureOrderMetadata(o);const itemList=(o.items||[]).map(i=>`<div class="itemrow"><div class="itemgrow"><strong>${esc(i.name)}</strong><div>${money(i.price)} × ${i.qty}</div></div></div>`).join('');const hist=(o.history||[]).map(h=>`<div class="history-line"><strong>${esc(h.status)}</strong> — ${esc(h.note||'')}<div class="small-muted">${esc(fmtStamp(h.at))}</div></div>`).join('');$('trackingResult').innerHTML=`<div class="tracking-result"><h3>${bn?'অর্ডারের অবস্থা':'Order status'}: <span class="badge">${esc(o.status||'Pending')}</span></h3><p><strong>${bn?'ট্রানজেকশন আইডি':'Transaction ID'}:</strong><br><span class="transaction-code">${esc(o.transactionId)}</span></p><p><strong>${bn?'ইউজারনেম':'Username'}:</strong> ${esc(o.username||o.customer||'Customer')}</p><p><strong>${bn?'অর্ডারের সময়':'Order placed'}:</strong> ${esc(fmtStamp(o.createdAt))}</p><p><strong>${bn?'পণ্য':'Product'}:</strong></p>${itemList}<p><strong>${bn?'মোট':'Total'}:</strong> ${money(o.total)}</p><p><strong>${bn?'বর্তমান স্ট্যাটাস':'Current status'}:</strong> ${esc(o.status||'Pending')}</p>${(o.status||'Pending')==='Pending'?`<p><strong>${bn?'Pending সময় চলছে':'Time pending'}:</strong> <span class="timer-chip tracking-time" data-track-elapsed="${esc(o.id)}">${esc(elapsed(o.createdAt))}</span></p>`:''}${o.confirmedAt?`<p><strong>${bn?'কনফার্মের তারিখ ও সময়':'Confirmed at'}:</strong> ${esc(fmtStamp(o.confirmedAt))}</p>`:''}<h4>${bn?'অর্ডারের ইতিহাস':'Order history'}</h4>${hist}</div>`;};
 // Show all orders in chronological history, username clickable to open full admin details.
 const oldRenderAdminHistory=renderAdmin;
 renderAdmin=function(){oldRenderAdminHistory();if($('allOrderHistory')){$('allOrderHistory').innerHTML=orders.length?[...orders].sort((a,b)=>(b.createdAt||0)-(a.createdAt||0)).map(o=>{ensureOrderMetadata(o);return `<div class="order"><div class="orderhead"><div><button type="button" class="link-button" data-history-user="${esc(o.id)}">${esc(o.username||o.customer||'Customer')}</button><div class="small-muted">${esc(o.transactionId)} · ${esc(fmtStamp(o.createdAt))}</div></div><span class="badge">${esc(o.status||'Pending')}</span></div><div class="small-muted">${(o.items||[]).map(i=>esc(i.name)+' × '+i.qty).join(', ')} · ${money(o.total)}</div><div class="history-line">${(o.history||[]).map(h=>`${esc(h.status)} — ${esc(fmtStamp(h.at))} (${esc(h.by||'')})`).join('<br>')}</div></div>`}).join(''):`<div class="empty">${currentLang==='bn'?'এখনো কোনো অর্ডার নেই।':'No orders yet.'}</div>`;$('allOrderHistory').querySelectorAll('[data-history-user]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>showOrderDetail(String(b.dataset.historyUser)));}}
 // The customer's own orders option searches by transaction ID; timer refreshes every second.
 setInterval(()=>{document.querySelectorAll('[data-track-elapsed]').forEach(el=>{const o=orders.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(el.dataset.trackElapsed));if(o&&o.status==='Pending')el.textContent=elapsed(o.createdAt)});},1000);
 applyLanguage();renderAdmin();
})();

</script><script>
// Final requested additions: customer order tracking and a local-demo admin session cap.
// Admins are allowed to share products, add to cart, and place orders like any customer.
(function(){
 const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
 const ADMIN_FLAG='hexamart_admin_active';
 const DEVICE_KEY='hexamart_admin_device_id';
 const SESSIONS_KEY='hexamart_admin_sessions_demo';
 function deviceId(){let id=localStorage.getItem(DEVICE_KEY);if(!id){id='dev-'+Date.now().toString(36)+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10);localStorage.setItem(DEVICE_KEY,id)}return id}
 function adminActive(){return sessionStorage.getItem(ADMIN_FLAG)==='yes'}
 function say(msg){if(typeof toast==='function')toast(msg);else alert(msg)}
 // Make Your Orders accessible in the shop header.
 const headerActions=document.querySelector('header.top .actions');
 if(headerActions&&!$('myOrdersBtn')){
   const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='secondary';b.id='myOrdersBtn';b.textContent=currentLang==='bn'?'🧾 আপনার অর্ডার':'🧾 Your Orders';
   headerActions.insertBefore(b,headerActions.firstChild);
   b.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(typeof show==='function')show('trackingView');$('trackingCode').value='';$('trackingResult').innerHTML='';});
 }
 // Preserve the existing order tracking search and ensure each placed order has a unique transaction ID.
 const oldCheckout=$('checkoutForm').onsubmit;
 $('checkoutForm').onsubmit=function(e){
   const before=new Set(orders.map(o=>o.id));
   if(oldCheckout)oldCheckout.call(this,e);
   const fresh=orders.find(o=>!before.has(o.id));
   if(fresh){
     let tx=fresh.transactionId;
     while(!tx||orders.some(o=>o!==fresh&&o.transactionId===tx))tx=uniqueTx();
     fresh.transactionId=tx;fresh.createdAt=fresh.createdAt||Date.now();fresh.status=fresh.status||'Pending';fresh.source='customer';save();
     say((currentLang==='bn'?'আপনার অর্ডার হয়েছে। ট্রানজেকশন আইডি: ':'Order placed. Transaction ID: ')+tx);
     const itemLines=(fresh.items||[]).map((it,i)=>`${i+1}. ${it.name} × ${it.qty} = ${money(Number(it.price||0)*Number(it.qty||0))}`).join('\n');
     const waMessage=[
       '🛍️ HexaMart — নতুন অর্ডার',
       'অর্ডার আইডি: '+(fresh.id||''),
       'ট্রানজেকশন আইডি: '+(fresh.transactionId||''),
       'নাম: '+(fresh.customer||''),
       'মোবাইল: '+(fresh.phone||''),
       'ঠিকানা: '+(fresh.address||''),
       'পণ্যসমূহ:',
       itemLines,
       'মোট: '+money(fresh.total),
       'পেমেন্ট: '+(fresh.payment||''),
       'স্ট্যাটাস: '+(fresh.status||'Pending')
     ].join('\n');
     // Keep checkout inside HexaMart. Automatic WhatsApp delivery requires a server/API; a static HTML file cannot send messages silently.
     console.info('Order saved locally. WhatsApp notification requires a server/API.', waMessage);
   }
 };
 // Admin shopping restrictions removed: admin can use cart, buy/order, and share products.
 // Limit active admin sessions to two in this browser's shared storage. Cross-device enforcement needs a server.
 const oldLogin=$('loginForm').onsubmit;
 $('loginForm').onsubmit=function(e){
   e.preventDefault();
   const pass=$('adminPass').value;
   if(pass!==ADMIN_PASSWORD){$('loginError').textContent=currentLang==='bn'?'পাসওয়ার্ড সঠিক নয়।':'Incorrect password.';return;}
   let sessions=[];try{sessions=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SESSIONS_KEY)||'[]')}catch(_){sessions=[]}
   const dev=deviceId();sessions=sessions.filter(x=>x&&x.device!==dev);
   if(sessions.length>=2){$('loginError').textContent=currentLang==='bn'?'অ্যাডমিন ফুল — সর্বোচ্চ ২টি ডিভাইস অনুমোদিত।':'Admin full — only 2 devices are allowed.';return;}
   sessions.push({device:dev,at:Date.now()});localStorage.setItem(SESSIONS_KEY,JSON.stringify(sessions));sessionStorage.setItem(ADMIN_FLAG,'yes');
   if(oldLogin)oldLogin.call(this,e);
   // If the existing handler didn't open the dashboard, set it directly after valid password.
   $('adminLogin').classList.add('hidden');$('adminDashboard').classList.remove('hidden');renderAdmin();
 };
 function releaseAdmin(){if(!adminActive())return;let sessions=[];try{sessions=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SESSIONS_KEY)||'[]')}catch(_){sessions=[]}sessions=sessions.filter(x=>x.device!==deviceId());localStorage.setItem(SESSIONS_KEY,JSON.stringify(sessions));sessionStorage.removeItem(ADMIN_FLAG)}
 const oldLogout=$('logout').onclick;$('logout').onclick=function(){releaseAdmin();if(oldLogout)oldLogout.call(this);};
 const oldBack=$('backFromAdmin').onclick;$('backFromAdmin').onclick=function(){releaseAdmin();if(oldBack)oldBack.call(this);};
 window.addEventListener('beforeunload',()=>{ /* Keep session while the tab remains; explicit logout releases it. */ });
 // Ensure the tracking view can be opened from the header even after language updates.
 const trackingBtn=$('myOrdersBtn');if(trackingBtn)trackingBtn.onclick=()=>{if(typeof show==='function')show('trackingView');$('trackingCode').value='';$('trackingResult').innerHTML='';};
})();
</script>
<script>
// HexaMart product sharing: share a direct URL that opens the selected product's checkout form.
(function(){
  document.addEventListener('click', async function(e){
    const btn=e.target.closest('[data-share-product]');
    if(!btn) return;
    e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
    const id=btn.getAttribute('data-share-product');
    const p=(typeof products!=='undefined')?products.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id)):null;
    // Keep the current hosted page as the base, but replace any previous shared-product parameters.
    const url=new URL(window.location.href);
    url.searchParams.delete('product');
    url.searchParams.delete('sharedProduct');
    url.searchParams.set('product', String(id));
    if(p){
      const payload={id:p.id,name:p.name,category:p.category||'অন্যান্য',price:Number(p.price)||0,stock:Math.max(1,Number(p.stock)||1),desc:p.desc||'',emoji:p.emoji||'📦',image:p.image||''};
      // URLSearchParams encodes JSON itself; do not pre-encode it.
      url.searchParams.set('sharedProduct', JSON.stringify(payload));
    }
    url.hash='';
    const shareUrl=url.toString();
    try {
      if(navigator.share) await navigator.share({title:p?('HexaMart - '+p.name):'HexaMart পণ্য', text:'এই পণ্যটি দেখুন এবং অর্ডার করুন', url:shareUrl});
      else if(navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext){await navigator.clipboard.writeText(shareUrl); if(typeof toast==='function')toast('পণ্যের লিংক কপি হয়েছে!'); else alert('পণ্যের লিংক কপি হয়েছে!');}
      else {window.prompt('এই পণ্যের লিংক কপি করে শেয়ার করুন:', shareUrl);}
    } catch(err) { if(err && err.name!=='AbortError') {window.prompt('এই পণ্যের লিংক কপি করে শেয়ার করুন:', shareUrl);} }
  });

  function openSharedProduct(){
    const params=new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const id=params.get('product');
    if(!id) return;
    const waitForProducts=()=>{
      if(typeof products==='undefined' || typeof show!=='function' || typeof renderCart!=='function') return false;
      let p=products.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id));
      if(!p){
        try{
          const raw=params.get('sharedProduct');
          if(raw){
            const shared=JSON.parse(raw);
            if(String(shared.id)===String(id) && shared.name){
              p={...shared,id:Number(shared.id),price:Number(shared.price)||0,stock:Math.max(1,Number(shared.stock)||1),image:shared.image||''};
              products.unshift(p);
              if(typeof save==='function')save();
            }
          }
        }catch(err){ console.warn('Shared product link could not be parsed',err); }
      }
      if(!p){if(typeof toast==='function')toast('এই শেয়ার লিংকে পণ্যের তথ্য পাওয়া যায়নি।');return true;}
      if(Number(p.stock)<=0){if(typeof toast==='function')toast('দুঃখিত, পণ্যটির স্টক শেষ।');return true;}
      // Normalize the ID to the numeric format used by the existing cart and checkout code.
      const productId=Number(p.id);
      if(!Number.isFinite(productId)){if(typeof toast==='function')toast('পণ্যের লিংকটি সঠিক নয়।');return true;}
      cart={};
      cart[productId]=1;
      if(typeof save==='function')save();
      if(typeof updateCartCount==='function')updateCartCount();
      show('cartView');
      renderCart();
      // Keep the original checkout form and WhatsApp flow unchanged; reveal the form for this shared item.
      const form=document.getElementById('checkoutForm');
      if(form){form.classList.remove('hidden'); form.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});}
      const nameField=document.getElementById('customerName');
      if(nameField)setTimeout(()=>nameField.focus({preventScroll:true}),250);
      return true;
    };
    let tries=0;
    const timer=setInterval(()=>{tries++; if(waitForProducts() || tries>60)clearInterval(timer);},100);
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',openSharedProduct);else openSharedProduct();
})();
</script>

<script>
(()=> {
 const NAGAD_LOGO="";
 const BKASH_LOGO="https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/039/340/798/non_2x/bkash-logo-free-vector.jpg";
 let videoData="";
 let selectedVideoBlob=null;
 const videoDBPromise=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
   const req=indexedDB.open("HexaMartMediaDB",1);
   req.onupgradeneeded=()=>{if(!req.result.objectStoreNames.contains("videos"))req.result.createObjectStore("videos")};
   req.onsuccess=()=>resolve(req.result);req.onerror=()=>reject(req.error);
 });
 async function saveProductVideo(id,blob){
   const db=await videoDBPromise;
   return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const tx=db.transaction("videos","readwrite");tx.objectStore("videos").put(blob,String(id));tx.oncomplete=resolve;tx.onerror=()=>reject(tx.error)});
 }
 async function getProductVideo(id){
   const db=await videoDBPromise;
   return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const req=db.transaction("videos","readonly").objectStore("videos").get(String(id));req.onsuccess=()=>resolve(req.result||null);req.onerror=()=>reject(req.error)});
 }
 const v=document.getElementById("pVideo");
 if(v) v.addEventListener("change",e=>{
   const f=e.target.files[0]; if(!f)return;
   if(!f.type.startsWith("video/")){toast("ভিডিও ফাইল নির্বাচন করুন।");e.target.value="";return;}
   if(f.size>80*1024*1024){toast("ভিডিও ৮০ MB-এর মধ্যে দিন।");e.target.value="";return;}
   selectedVideoBlob=f;toast("ভিডিও যুক্ত হয়েছে। পণ্য সেভ করলে সংরক্ষিত হবে।");
 });
 const oldEdit=window.editProduct;
 window.editProduct=function(id){oldEdit(id);const p=products.find(x=>x.id===id);$("pDelivery").value=p?.delivery||0;videoData=p?.video||"";selectedVideoBlob=null};
 const oldReset=window.resetProductForm;
 window.resetProductForm=function(){oldReset();videoData="";selectedVideoBlob=null;if($("pVideo"))$("pVideo").value="";if($("pDelivery"))$("pDelivery").value=0};
 $("productForm").onsubmit=async e=>{
   e.preventDefault();
   let id=$("editId").value?+$("editId").value:Date.now(),old=products.find(p=>p.id===id);
   if(selectedVideoBlob){
     try{await saveProductVideo(id,selectedVideoBlob);videoData="idb:"+id;}
     catch(err){toast("ভিডিও সংরক্ষণ করা যায়নি। অন্য ভিডিও চেষ্টা করুন।");return;}
   }else videoData=old?.video||"";
   let p={id,name:$("pName").value.trim(),category:$("pCategory").value.trim()||"অন্যান্য",price:Number($("pPrice").value),stock:Number($("pStock").value),desc:$("pDesc").value.trim(),delivery:Number($("pDelivery").value)||0,video:videoData,emoji:old?.emoji||"📦",image:imageData||(old?.image||"")};
   if(!p.name||p.price<0||p.stock<0||p.delivery<0)return;
   if(old)products=products.map(x=>x.id===id?p:x);else products.unshift(p);
   if(!save())return;resetProductForm();renderAll();toast(old?"পণ্য আপডেট হয়েছে।":"নতুন পণ্য যোগ হয়েছে।");
 };
 function paymentGuide(){
   let pay=$("payment").value,box=$("paymentGuide"),tx=$("transactionInput");
   if(pay==="ক্যাশ অন ডেলিভারি"){box.classList.add("hidden");tx.required=false;tx.value="";return}
   let bk=pay==="বিকাশ",color=bk?"#e2136e":"#f5a800",name=bk?"বিকাশ":"নগদ";
   let logo=bk?BKASH_LOGO:"data:image/png;base64,"+NAGAD_LOGO;
   box.classList.remove("hidden");box.style.background=bk?"#fff0f6":"#fff8df";box.style.borderColor=color;
   box.innerHTML=`<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px"><img src="${logo}" alt="${name}" style="width:62px;height:62px;object-fit:contain;background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:4px"><b style="font-size:20px;color:${color}">${name} পেমেন্ট</b></div><p style="margin-top:10px">১. ${name} অ্যাপ ওপেন করুন।<br>২. Send Money নির্বাচন করুন।<br>৩. প্রাপকের নম্বর হিসেবে <b>01689930749</b> লিখুন/নির্বাচন করুন।<br>৪. পণ্যের মূল্য ও ডেলিভারি চার্জসহ সর্বমোট সঠিক টাকা পাঠান।<br>৫. পেমেন্ট সম্পন্ন হলে Transaction ID নিচের ঘরে লিখুন।</p><p style="color:#b42318;font-weight:700">ভুল Transaction ID দিলে আপনার অর্ডার কনফার্ম করা হবে না। টাকা পাঠানোর আগে নম্বর ও পরিমাণ ভালোভাবে যাচাই করুন।</p>`;
   tx.required=true;tx.placeholder="এখানে Transaction ID লিখুন";
 }
 $("payment").addEventListener("change",paymentGuide);paymentGuide();
 const oldRender=window.renderCart;
 window.renderCart=function(){
   oldRender();let ids=Object.keys(cart).filter(id=>cart[id]>0&&products.some(p=>p.id===+id));
   let sub=ids.reduce((a,id)=>a+products.find(p=>p.id===+id).price*cart[id],0);
   let ship=ids.reduce((a,id)=>a+(products.find(p=>p.id===+id).delivery||0),0);
   $("cartTotal").textContent="পণ্যের মূল্য: "+money(sub)+" · ডেলিভারি: "+money(ship)+" · সর্বমোট: "+money(sub+ship);
 };
 $("checkoutForm").onsubmit=e=>{
   e.preventDefault();let pay=$("payment").value,tx=$("transactionInput").value.trim();
   if(pay!=="ক্যাশ অন ডেলিভারি"&&!tx){toast("ট্রানজেকশন আইডি দিন।");$("transactionInput").focus();return}
   let ids=Object.keys(cart).filter(id=>cart[id]>0);if(!ids.length)return;
   for(let id of ids){let p=products.find(x=>x.id===+id);if(!p||cart[id]>p.stock){toast("স্টক পরিবর্তন হয়েছে।");renderCart();return}}
   let items=ids.map(id=>{let p=products.find(x=>x.id===+id);return{id:p.id,name:p.name,price:p.price,qty:cart[id],delivery:p.delivery||0}});
   let subtotal=items.reduce((a,x)=>a+x.price*x.qty,0),delivery=items.reduce((a,x)=>a+x.delivery,0);
   let order={id:"HM"+Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase()+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6).toUpperCase(),transactionId:tx||uniqueTx(),customerTransactionId:tx,createdAt:Date.now(),date:new Date().toLocaleString("bn-BD"),customer:$("customerName").value.trim(),username:(accountGet()?.username||accountGet()?.email||$("customerName").value.trim()),phone:$("phone").value.trim(),address:$("address").value.trim(),payment:pay,items,total:subtotal+delivery,subtotal,delivery,status:"Pending"};
   items.forEach(x=>{let p=products.find(y=>y.id===x.id);p.stock-=x.qty});orders.unshift(order);cart={};save();$("checkoutForm").reset();paymentGuide();renderAll();show("shopView");toast("অর্ডার জমা হয়েছে। WhatsApp-এ অর্ডারের তথ্য খুলছে।");
   const site=location.href.split("?")[0].split("#")[0];
   const waText=["নতুন HexaMart অর্ডার","অর্ডার আইডি: "+order.id,"তারিখ: "+order.date,"গ্রাহক: "+order.customer,"ফোন: "+order.phone,"ঠিকানা: "+order.address,"পেমেন্ট: "+order.payment,"Transaction ID: "+(order.customerTransactionId||"প্রযোজ্য নয়"),"পণ্যসমূহ:",...items.map(x=>"- "+x.name+" × "+x.qty+" = "+money(x.price*x.qty)),"পণ্যের মূল্য: "+money(order.subtotal),"ডেলিভারি চার্জ: "+money(order.delivery),"সর্বমোট: "+money(order.total),"ওয়েবসাইট: "+site].join("\n");
   window.open("https://wa.me/8801689930749?text="+encodeURIComponent(waText),"_blank","noopener");
 };
 const prevAdmin=window.renderAdmin;
 window.renderAdmin=function(){prevAdmin();document.querySelectorAll("#adminProducts .adminProduct").forEach(el=>{let id=Number(el.getAttribute("data-admin-order")),p=products.find(x=>x.id===id);if(p?.desc){let note=document.createElement("div");note.className="small-muted";note.textContent="শুধু অ্যাডমিন: "+p.desc;el.querySelector(".adminButtons")?.before(note)}if(p?.delivery){let fee=document.createElement("div");fee.className="small-muted";fee.textContent="ডেলিভারি চার্জ: "+money(p.delivery);el.querySelector(".adminButtons")?.before(fee)}})};
 // Customer product cards show only product title/price/photo; private note stays admin-only.
 const originalProducts=window.renderProducts;
 window.renderProducts=function(){originalProducts();document.querySelectorAll("#productGrid .product").forEach(card=>{
   let p=products.find(x=>x.name===card.querySelector("h3")?.textContent);if(!p)return;
   card.querySelectorAll(".info .muted").forEach(el=>{if(el.textContent===p.desc)el.remove()});
   let b=document.createElement("button");b.className="secondary";b.textContent="বিস্তারিত / ভিডিও দেখুন";
   b.onclick=()=>{let d=document.createElement("div");d.className="panel";d.style.cssText="position:fixed;inset:12px;z-index:1300;overflow:auto;max-width:700px;margin:auto;box-shadow:0 15px 50px #0006";
     d.innerHTML=`<div class="sectionhead"><h2>${esc(p.name)}</h2><button class="secondary" id="closePD">বন্ধ</button></div>${p.image?`<img src="${p.image}" style="width:100%;max-height:280px;object-fit:contain">`:""}${p.video?`<video id="productDetailVideo" controls playsinline style="width:100%;max-height:320px"></video>`:""}<div class="price">${p.priceMode==="coins"?"🪙 "+Number(p.coinPrice||1)+" কয়েন":money(p.price)}</div>${p.priceMode!=="coins"&&Number(p.coinReward)>0?`<p>অর্ডার করলে একবার ${Number(p.coinReward)} কয়েন পুরস্কার পাবেন</p>`:""}<p>ডেলিভারি চার্জ: ${money(p.delivery||0)}</p><p>স্টক: ${p.stock}</p><button id="buyPD">অর্ডার করুন</button>`;
     document.body.appendChild(d);
     if(p.video){const player=d.querySelector("#productDetailVideo");if(p.video.startsWith("idb:")){getProductVideo(p.id).then(blob=>{if(blob&&player){player.src=URL.createObjectURL(blob)}}).catch(()=>toast("ভিডিওটি পাওয়া যায়নি।"));}else{player.src=p.video;}}
     d.querySelector("#closePD").onclick=()=>{const player=d.querySelector("#productDetailVideo");if(player?.src.startsWith("blob:"))URL.revokeObjectURL(player.src);d.remove()};d.querySelector("#buyPD").onclick=()=>{d.remove();cart={[p.id]:1};save();updateCartCount();show("cartView");renderCart()};
   };card.querySelector(".info").appendChild(b);
 });};

 // ===== HexaMart Coins + Payment visibility extension =====
 const coinKey="hexamart_coin_balances";
 const normalizeCoinUser=u=>String(u??"").trim().toLowerCase();
 const coinBalances=()=>{try{let v=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(coinKey)||"{}");return v&&typeof v==="object"&&!Array.isArray(v)?v:{}}catch{return {}}};
 const activeUser=()=>{try{let a=accountGet?.();return normalizeCoinUser(a?.username||a?.email||"")}catch{return ""}};
 const rewardKey="hexamart_coin_reward_claims";
 const rewardClaims=()=>{try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(rewardKey)||"{}")}catch{return {}}};
 const getCoins=(u=activeUser())=>{let key=normalizeCoinUser(u),b=coinBalances();if(!key)return 0;let found=Object.keys(b).find(k=>normalizeCoinUser(k)===key);return Math.max(0,Number(b[found]||0)||0)};
 const setCoins=(u,n)=>{let key=normalizeCoinUser(u);if(!key)return false;let b=coinBalances();Object.keys(b).forEach(k=>{if(normalizeCoinUser(k)===key&&k!==key)delete b[k]});b[key]=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(n)||0));localStorage.setItem(coinKey,JSON.stringify(b));updateCoinBadge();return true};
 const updateCoinBadge=()=>{let el=$("coinBalanceValue");if(el)el.textContent=getCoins().toLocaleString("en-BD")};
 const topActions=document.querySelector(".top .actions");
 if(topActions&&!$("coinBalanceBtn")){let b=document.createElement("button");b.id="coinBalanceBtn";b.className="secondary";b.innerHTML="🪙 ব্যালেন্স: <b id='coinBalanceValue'>0</b>";topActions.insertBefore(b,topActions.firstChild);b.onclick=()=>toast("আপনার কয়েন ব্যালেন্স: "+getCoins())}
 updateCoinBadge();
 const productForm=$("productForm");
 if(productForm&&!$("pPriceMode")){
   let priceRow=$("pPrice").closest(".row");
   let wrap=document.createElement("div");wrap.className="row";
   wrap.innerHTML='<div><label class="label" for="pPriceMode">পণ্যের মূল্য পদ্ধতি</label><select class="field" id="pPriceMode"><option value="money">টাকা (৳)</option><option value="coins">কয়েন (🪙)</option></select></div><div id="coinPriceWrap" class="hidden"><label class="label" for="pCoinPrice">কয়েনের দাম *</label><input class="field" id="pCoinPrice" type="number" min="1" step="1" value="1"></div><div id="coinRewardWrap"><label class="label" for="pCoinReward">টাকায় অর্ডার করলে কয়েন পুরস্কার (একবারই)</label><input class="field" id="pCoinReward" type="number" min="0" step="1" value="0" placeholder="যেমন: ৫০"></div>';
   priceRow.insertAdjacentElement("afterend",wrap);
   $("pPriceMode").addEventListener("change",()=>{let isCoin=$("pPriceMode").value==="coins";$("coinPriceWrap").classList.toggle("hidden",!isCoin);$("coinRewardWrap").classList.toggle("hidden",isCoin);$("pPrice").closest(".row").querySelector('label[for="pPrice"]').textContent=isCoin?"টাকার রেফারেন্স দাম (ঐচ্ছিক)":"দাম (৳) *"});
 }
 const previousProductSubmit=productForm.onsubmit;
 productForm.onsubmit=async e=>{
   e.preventDefault();
   let id=$("editId").value?+$("editId").value:Date.now(),old=products.find(p=>p.id===id);
   if(selectedVideoBlob){try{await saveProductVideo(id,selectedVideoBlob);videoData="idb:"+id}catch(err){toast("ভিডিও সংরক্ষণ করা যায়নি।");return}}else videoData=old?.video||"";
   let mode=$("pPriceMode")?.value||old?.priceMode||"money";
   let p={id,name:$("pName").value.trim(),category:$("pCategory").value.trim()||"অন্যান্য",price:Number($("pPrice").value)||0,coinPrice:Math.max(1,Number($("pCoinPrice")?.value)||1),coinReward:mode==="money"?Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number($("pCoinReward")?.value)||0)):0,priceMode:mode,stock:Number($("pStock").value),desc:$("pDesc").value.trim(),delivery:mode==="coins"?0:(Number($("pDelivery").value)||0),video:videoData,emoji:old?.emoji||"📦",image:imageData||(old?.image||"")};
   if(!p.name||p.stock<0||(mode==="money"&&p.price<0))return;
   if(old)products=products.map(x=>x.id===id?p:x);else products.unshift(p);
   if(!save())return;resetProductForm();renderAll();toast(old?"পণ্য আপডেট হয়েছে।":"নতুন পণ্য যোগ হয়েছে।");
 };
 const prevEditProduct=window.editProduct;
 window.editProduct=function(id){prevEditProduct(id);let p=products.find(x=>x.id===id);if(p){$("pPriceMode").value=p.priceMode||"money";$("pCoinPrice").value=p.coinPrice||1;$("pCoinReward").value=p.coinReward||0;$("coinPriceWrap").classList.toggle("hidden",$("pPriceMode").value!=="coins");$("coinRewardWrap").classList.toggle("hidden",$("pPriceMode").value==="coins")}};
 const prevResetProduct=window.resetProductForm;
 window.resetProductForm=function(){prevResetProduct();if($("pPriceMode")){$("pPriceMode").value="money";$("pCoinPrice").value=1;$("pCoinReward").value=0;$("coinPriceWrap").classList.add("hidden");$("coinRewardWrap").classList.remove("hidden")}};
 // Admin coin controls: render in the products workspace and use direct button handlers.
 const coinPanelHost=$("adminProductsWorkspace")||$("productManagementWorkspace")||$("productForm")?.parentElement;
 if(coinPanelHost){
   $("adminCoinPanel")?.remove();
   const box=document.createElement("div");
   box.id="adminCoinPanel";
   box.className="panel";
   box.style.cssText="margin:16px 0;padding:16px;border:1px solid var(--border,#ddd);border-radius:12px";
   box.innerHTML='<h3>🪙 ইউজারের কয়েন ব্যালেন্স নিয়ন্ত্রণ</h3><label class="label" for="coinTargetUser">গ্রাহকের ইউজারনেম</label><input class="field" id="coinTargetUser" autocomplete="off" placeholder="ইউজারনেম লিখুন"><label class="label" for="coinGrantAmount">কয়েনের পরিমাণ</label><input class="field" id="coinGrantAmount" type="number" min="1" step="1" value="10"><p>বর্তমান ব্যালেন্স: <b id="coinTargetBalance">0</b> কয়েন</p><div class="row" style="gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap"><button type="button" id="grantCoinsBtn">＋ কয়েন যোগ করুন</button><button type="button" id="takeCoinsBtn" class="secondary">－ কয়েন কেটে নিন</button></div><p id="coinAdminResult" role="status" aria-live="polite" style="margin-top:10px"></p><small>নোট: এই সংস্করণে কয়েন এই ব্রাউজারের Local Storage-এ সংরক্ষিত হয়।</small>';
   coinPanelHost.insertBefore(box,coinPanelHost.firstChild);
   const targetInput=$("coinTargetUser"),amountInput=$("coinGrantAmount"),balanceOutput=$("coinTargetBalance"),resultOutput=$("coinAdminResult");
   const refreshAdminCoinBalance=()=>{const u=normalizeCoinUser(targetInput.value);balanceOutput.textContent=String(getCoins(u));};
   targetInput.addEventListener("input",refreshAdminCoinBalance);
   const validateAdminCoinInput=()=>{const u=normalizeCoinUser(targetInput.value);const raw=String(amountInput.value||"").trim();const n=Number(raw);if(!u){resultOutput.textContent="আগে গ্রাহকের ইউজারনেম লিখুন।";targetInput.focus();return null;}if(!raw||!Number.isSafeInteger(n)||n<=0){resultOutput.textContent="কয়েনের পরিমাণ ১ বা তার বেশি পূর্ণসংখ্যা হতে হবে।";amountInput.focus();return null;}return {u,n};};
   $("grantCoinsBtn").onclick=()=>{const v=validateAdminCoinInput();if(!v)return;const before=getCoins(v.u);const ok=setCoins(v.u,before+v.n);if(!ok){resultOutput.textContent="কয়েন যোগ করা যায়নি।";return;}refreshAdminCoinBalance();resultOutput.textContent="সফল! "+v.u+"-কে "+v.n+" কয়েন যোগ হয়েছে। নতুন ব্যালেন্স: "+getCoins(v.u)+" কয়েন।";};
   $("takeCoinsBtn").onclick=()=>{const v=validateAdminCoinInput();if(!v)return;const before=getCoins(v.u);if(before<v.n){resultOutput.textContent="কাটা যায়নি। "+v.u+"-এর ব্যালেন্স "+before+" কয়েন, কিন্তু আপনি কাটতে চেয়েছেন "+v.n+" কয়েন।";refreshAdminCoinBalance();return;}const ok=setCoins(v.u,before-v.n);if(!ok){resultOutput.textContent="কয়েন কাটা যায়নি।";return;}refreshAdminCoinBalance();resultOutput.textContent="সফল! "+v.u+"-এর "+v.n+" কয়েন কাটা হয়েছে। বাকি ব্যালেন্স: "+getCoins(v.u)+" কয়েন।";};
 }
 // Show price type on product cards and cart.
 const renderProductsWithCoins=window.renderProducts;
 window.renderProducts=function(){renderProductsWithCoins();document.querySelectorAll("#productGrid .product").forEach(card=>{let p=products.find(x=>x.name===card.querySelector("h3")?.textContent);if(!p)return;let price=card.querySelector(".price");if(price)price.textContent=(p.priceMode==="coins"?"🪙 "+Number(p.coinPrice||1).toLocaleString("en-BD")+" কয়েন":money(p.price)+(Number(p.coinReward)>0?" · কিনলে "+Number(p.coinReward)+" কয়েন পাবেন":""));})};
 const renderCartWithCoins=window.renderCart;
 window.renderCart=function(){renderCartWithCoins();let ids=Object.keys(cart).filter(id=>cart[id]>0&&products.some(p=>p.id===+id)),ps=ids.map(id=>products.find(p=>p.id===+id));if(!ps.length)return;let coin=ps.some(p=>p.priceMode==="coins");if(coin&&ps.some(p=>p.priceMode!=="coins")){ $("cartTotal").textContent="টাকা ও কয়েনের পণ্য একসাথে অর্ডার করা যাবে না।";$("checkoutForm").classList.add("hidden");return }$("checkoutForm").classList.remove("hidden");document.querySelector('label[for="payment"]')?.classList.toggle("hidden",coin);$("payment").classList.toggle("hidden",coin);$("paymentGuide").classList.toggle("hidden",coin);document.querySelector('label[for="transactionInput"]')?.classList.toggle("hidden",coin);$("transactionInput").classList.toggle("hidden",coin);$("transactionInput").required=!coin&&$("payment").value!=="ক্যাশ অন ডেলিভারি";if(coin){let total=ids.reduce((a,id)=>a+(Number(products.find(p=>p.id===+id).coinPrice)||1)*cart[id],0);$("cartTotal").textContent="মোট: 🪙 "+total+" কয়েন · আপনার ব্যালেন্স: "+getCoins()+" কয়েন"}else{let sub=ids.reduce((a,id)=>a+products.find(p=>p.id===+id).price*cart[id],0),ship=ids.reduce((a,id)=>a+(products.find(p=>p.id===+id).delivery||0),0);$("cartTotal").textContent="পণ্যের মূল্য: "+money(sub)+" · ডেলিভারি: "+money(ship)+" · সর্বমোট: "+money(sub+ship)}};
 $("payment").addEventListener("change",()=>{let pay=$("payment").value,showTx=pay!=="ক্যাশ অন ডেলিভারি";$("transactionInput").classList.toggle("hidden",!showTx);$("transactionInput").required=showTx;if(!showTx)$("transactionInput").value=""});
 const originalCheckout=$("checkoutForm").onsubmit;
 $("checkoutForm").onsubmit=e=>{
   e.preventDefault();
   let ids=Object.keys(cart).filter(id=>cart[id]>0);if(!ids.length)return;
   let ps=ids.map(id=>products.find(p=>p.id===+id));if(ps.some(p=>!p||cart[p.id]>p.stock)){toast("স্টক পরিবর্তন হয়েছে।");renderCart();return}
   let coin=ps.some(p=>p.priceMode==="coins");if(coin&&ps.some(p=>p.priceMode!=="coins")){toast("টাকা ও কয়েনের পণ্য আলাদা অর্ডার করুন।");return}
   if((coin||ps.some(p=>Number(p.coinReward)>0))&&!activeUser()){toast("কয়েন পেতে বা কয়েন দিয়ে কিনতে আগে অ্যাকাউন্টে লগইন করুন।");return}
   let pay=coin?"কয়েন":$("payment").value,tx=coin?"":$("transactionInput").value.trim();
   if(!coin&&pay!=="ক্যাশ অন ডেলিভারি"&&!tx){toast("ট্রানজেকশন আইডি দিন।");$("transactionInput").focus();return}
   let subtotal=ids.reduce((a,id)=>{let p=products.find(x=>x.id===+id);return a+(coin?Number(p.coinPrice||1):Number(p.price||0))*cart[id]},0),delivery=coin?0:ids.reduce((a,id)=>a+(products.find(x=>x.id===+id).delivery||0),0),total=subtotal+delivery;
   if(coin&&getCoins()<total){toast("আপনার ব্যালেন্স নেই।");return}
   let items=ids.map(id=>{let p=products.find(x=>x.id===+id);return{id:p.id,name:p.name,price:p.price,coinPrice:p.coinPrice||1,priceMode:p.priceMode||"money",qty:cart[id],delivery:p.delivery||0}});
   if(coin)setCoins(activeUser(),getCoins()-total);
   let earnedRewards=[];
   if(!coin){let u=activeUser();if(u){let claims=rewardClaims();if(!claims[u])claims[u]=[];items.forEach(it=>{let pr=products.find(x=>x.id===it.id),reward=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(pr?.coinReward)||0));if(reward>0&&!claims[u].includes(String(it.id))){claims[u].push(String(it.id));setCoins(u,getCoins(u)+reward);earnedRewards.push({product:it.name,coins:reward});}});localStorage.setItem(rewardKey,JSON.stringify(claims));}}
   let order={id:"HM"+Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase()+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6).toUpperCase(),transactionId:tx||uniqueTx(),customerTransactionId:tx,createdAt:Date.now(),date:new Date().toLocaleString("bn-BD"),customer:$("customerName").value.trim(),username:(accountGet()?.username||accountGet()?.email||$("customerName").value.trim()),phone:$("phone").value.trim(),address:$("address").value.trim(),payment:pay,items,total,subtotal,delivery,status:"Pending",coinPaid:coin?total:0,coinRewards:earnedRewards};
   items.forEach(x=>{let p=products.find(y=>y.id===x.id);p.stock-=x.qty});orders.unshift(order);cart={};save();$("checkoutForm").reset();paymentGuide();renderAll();updateCoinBadge();show("shopView");toast("অর্ডার জমা হয়েছে। WhatsApp-এ অর্ডারের তথ্য খুলছে।");
   const site=location.href.split("?")[0].split("#")[0],waText=["নতুন HexaMart অর্ডার","অর্ডার আইডি: "+order.id,"তারিখ: "+order.date,"গ্রাহক: "+order.customer,"ফোন: "+order.phone,"ঠিকানা: "+order.address,"পেমেন্ট: "+order.payment,"কয়েন খরচ: "+(coin?total+" কয়েন":"প্রযোজ্য নয়"),"কয়েন পুরস্কার: "+(earnedRewards.length?earnedRewards.map(r=>r.product+" = "+r.coins+" কয়েন").join(", "):"নতুন পুরস্কার নেই / আগেই নেওয়া হয়েছে"),"Transaction ID: "+(tx||"প্রযোজ্য নয়"),"পণ্যসমূহ:",...items.map(x=>"- "+x.name+" × "+x.qty+" = "+(coin?(x.coinPrice*x.qty)+" কয়েন":money(x.price*x.qty))),"সর্বমোট: "+(coin?total+" কয়েন":money(total)),"ওয়েবসাইট: "+site].join("\n");
   window.open("https://wa.me/8801689930749?text="+encodeURIComponent(waText),"_blank","noopener");
 };

})();
</script>
</body></html>
